rows: vercel vercel hobby static & frontend hosting 100 gb fast data transfer/month, 1m edge requests/month and included vercel functions on the free hobby plan hobby is for personal, non-commercial projects only; not for running a business or commercial saas. on most quotas, exceeding the free allowance stops the affected feature until the usage period resets. pro features and its 14-day promotional trial are separate.

netlify netlify free static & frontend hosting 300 free plan credits/month for deployments, requests, bandwidth and compute; custom domains and https included credits are shared across production deploys, web requests, bandwidth and compute. the ongoing $0 free plan is distinct from any promotional credits; overages/auto-recharge can result in charges if a paid add-on is enabled (auto-recharge is disabled by default). legacy account terms may differ.

cloudflare-pages cloudflare pages static & frontend hosting 500 builds/month on free; 20,000 files/site, 25 mib maximum per file and up to 100 custom domains/project one concurrent build per free account; 20-minute build timeout. pages functions consume the separate workers quota (100,000 free requests/day with 10 ms cpu time each), not unlimited backend compute.

github-pages github pages static & frontend hosting public-repository static hosting on github free; published site up to 1 gb and a soft 100 gb/month bandwidth limit github pages is not allowed as free hosting for an online business, e-commerce site or commercial saas. deployment builds time out at 10 minutes; default pages builds have a soft limit of 10/hour (not applicable to custom actions publication).

firebase-hosting firebase hosting (spark) static & frontend hosting firebase hosting on spark: 10 gb stored and 360 mb/day transferred; custom domain and ssl included spark needs no payment method. the 360 mb/day hosting transfer quota is not a recurring monthly bandwidth allowance; other firebase products have separate free caps. firebase app hosting and its billed resources are not available on spark.

azure-static-web-apps azure static web apps free static & frontend hosting free static web app plan: 100 gb bandwidth per subscription, 2 custom domains/app and free managed ssl for hobby/personal projects; no sla or standard-plan features. free includes 0.50 gb storage overall with a 0.25 gb maximum size per app deployment. when bandwidth quota is exceeded, the site cannot be served.

render-static render static sites static & frontend hosting free static-site deploys with automatic tls, subject to shared workspace outbound bandwidth and build-pipeline allowances static sites do not use free web-instance hours, but share workspace bandwidth and pipeline-minute quotas. if you add a payment method, excess outbound bandwidth or pipeline minutes may be billed; without one, render restricts service/builds until the next billing period.

deplexo-free deplexo free hosting backend & app hosting one always-on free app: 0.25 vcpu, 128 mb ram, 250 mb disk, 100 gb monthly transfer and 10 mbit/s network bandwidth no payment card or automatic sleep on the free plan, but resources are shared and capped at 0.25 vcpu, 128 mb ram, 250 mb disk and 10 mbit/s. at the 100 gb monthly account transfer limit, apps stop until the next month or a plan upgrade. no independent uptime guarantee; not a dedicated vps.

render-web render free web services backend & app hosting 750 free web-instance hours/workspace per calendar month; unused hours do not carry over a free web service spins down after 15 minutes without inbound http or websocket traffic; waking may take about a minute. its local filesystem is ephemeral and no persistent disk is available. excess bandwidth/build minutes can be billed if a payment method is on file; otherwise services or builds are suspended. not for production.

koyeb koyeb free instance (legacy starter only) backend & app hosting existing starter-plan organizations only: one free web instance with 512 mb ram, 0.1 vcpu and 2 gb ssd not available as a free signup for new users: koyeb's february 17, 2026 announcement requires new registrations to choose pro or another paid plan and provide a payment method. existing starter organizations retain their free plan; do not treat this as a new-user free tier. paid plan subscription/overage charges apply; instance regions, scale-to-zero and persistent-volume restrictions still apply.

railway railway free backend & app hosting $1 recurring free-plan credit/month after a one-time $5 trial credit lasting up to 30 days railway free is $0/month; its $1 recurring credit does not roll over. new users initially receive a one-time $5 trial grant that expires after 30 days or when depleted; trial accounts can have restricted outbound networking until verification. trial stateful volumes may be deleted 30 days after credit expiry. monitor resource usage and billing before upgrading.

deno-deploy deno deploy free backend & app hosting free deno deploy: 1m inbound requests/month, 20 gib egress/month, 5 custom domains, 10 active cpu hours and 150 gib-hours of memory time full published free allowances require organization verification with a credit card; unverified organizations receive restricted free limits. apps are paused when request, egress, cpu or memory limits are exhausted until the billing cycle resets. pro/builder charge for overages; this is new deno deploy, not retired deploy classic (sunset july 20, 2026). commercial eligibility should be verified with deno.

prisma-compute prisma compute free backend & app hosting 1 million requests/month; 360 gb-hours memory/month; 4 active vcpu-hours/month; 10 gb outbound bandwidth/month free has a fixed $0 spend limit, requires no credit card and never bills usage overages. if any monthly request, provisioned-memory, active-cpu or outbound-bandwidth allowance is exceeded, the workspace's apps pause until the next month or a plan upgrade; do not mistake a traffic spike for billable overage. an idle app scales to zero. starter and higher tiers bill memory, cpu and outbound bandwidth from the first unit, plus requests beyond their included quotas; paid spend limits must be configured separately. typescript hosting (node.js, bun, next.js).

cloudflare-workers cloudflare workers free serverless & edge 100,000 requests/day and 10 ms cpu time per invocation on workers free workers free has a daily request cap and per-invocation cpu time cap, not continuously running server compute. pages functions use the same workers quota; paid worker plans have different billing and higher limits.

google-cloud-run google cloud run serverless & edge request-based cloud run free tier: 2m requests, 180,000 vcpu-seconds and 360,000 gib-seconds of memory/month; 1 gb eligible north america outbound transfer requires an active cloud billing account and valid payment method. the request-based free tier differs from instance-based billing; cloud build, artifact registry, logging, network egress and other products may charge separately. paid billing accounts are charged for usage beyond the free allowance; a free trial account draws from its limited trial credit.

oracle-cloud oracle cloud always free compute cloud compute & vps always free: up to two amd e2.1.micro vms (1/8 ocpu, 1 gb ram each); arm ampere a1: 1,500 ocpu-hours and 9,000 gb-hours/month (equivalent to 2 ocpus and 12 gb ram for always free tenancies); 200 gb shared boot/block volume storage. compute must run in the home region; capacity may be unavailable and idle instances may be reclaimed. payment card required for account verification. boot volumes use the shared 200 gb allowance; paid account overages can incur charges. verify tenancy-specific a1 limits.

gce-e2-micro google compute engine free tier cloud compute & vps one non-preemptible e2-micro vm-month (aggregate hours), 30 gb-months standard persistent disk and 1 gb eligible outbound data/month free e2-micro usage only in us-west1, us-central1 or us-east1. the vm allowance is pooled by running hours across those regions, not one free vm in every region. gpus/tpus, other disk types, excess egress, ip addresses and other billable resources are not covered. an active cloud billing account is required.

aws-free-plan aws free plan cloud compute & vps new eligible aws customers: free account plan for up to 6 months or until aws free tier credits are exhausted; $100 signup credit plus up to $100 earned through activities the free account plan is a time-limited account offer, not an always-free vps. it ends at 6 months or credit exhaustion, whichever comes first; aws automatically closes the free account and resources/data become inaccessible unless upgraded. joining aws organizations upgrades to paid and ends free plan credit eligibility. some services offer separate always-free monthly usage; paid-plan usage beyond allowances can incur charges.

convex-free convex free databases & caching free plan: 0.5 gb database storage, 1 gb database i/o/month, 1 million function calls/month, 20 gb-hours action compute/month and 1 gb file storage free limits are measured across the team (not per project); includes 0.5 gb search storage and 3,000 query-gbs/month for search. exceeding free caps for a sustained period may cause function calls or mutations to fail; the separate starter plan can charge usage-based overages. the free allowance is ongoing, not a trial.

supabase supabase free databases & caching free: 500 mb postgres/project, 2 active projects, 50k monthly active users, 1 gb file storage and 5 gb egress free projects pause after one week of inactivity. the 500 mb database is on shared cpu/500 mb ram; the 5 gb cached egress is a separate quota. daily backups and longer log retention require pro. paid add-ons/extra compute are not part of the $0 free plan.

turso turso free databases & caching free: 100 databases, 5 gb total storage, 500m rows read and 10m rows written/month, plus 3 gb monthly sync turso's $0 free plan has no credit card requirement, but reads, writes, storage and embedded sync each have independent limits. free has 1-day audit log retention; point-in-time restore and deleted database recovery are paid-plan features. avoid treating 3 gb sync as unlimited network traffic.

mongodb-atlas mongodb atlas free cluster databases & caching mongodb atlas m0 free cluster: 512 mb total storage including indexes; shared ram/vcpu the m0 free tier is ongoing but constrained to development/learning, with region, throughput and feature limits. a separate no-signup ephemeral m0 cluster is not durable: it pauses after 2 days and is deleted after 7 days unless claimed. do not confuse ephemeral signup flow with a claimed free atlas cluster or a paid flex cluster.

upstash-redis upstash redis free databases & caching one free upstash redis database: 256 mb data, 500,000 commands/month and 10 gb monthly bandwidth instant databases created without signup are deleted after 3 days unless claimed in an account. the claimed free tier has ongoing monthly quotas; entering a credit card upgrades the database to pay-as-you-go pricing, whose usage is charged separately.

upstash-vector upstash vector free databases & caching one free vector index: 10,000 queries/day and 10,000 updates/day; up to 1 gb vector metadata/data, 1,536 dimensions and 100 namespaces the free index is limited to 200 million vector dimensions, 1 gb total data/metadata and 100 namespaces, with no uptime sla. entering a payment card upgrades that index to metered pay-as-you-go; do not confuse ongoing free quotas with a paid or one-time trial.

cloudflare-d1 cloudflare d1 free databases & caching workers free d1: 5 gb total storage, 10 databases/account, 5m rows read/day and 100k rows written/day daily read/write allowances reset at 00:00 utc. on free, exhausted row quotas return query errors and hitting storage cap prevents further writes/schema changes; indexes also count toward stored data and row writes. workers paid allows additional billable databases and metered usage. workers invocation quotas apply separately.

cloudflare-hyperdrive cloudflare hyperdrive free databases & caching 100,000 database sql statements/day through hyperdrive on workers free; up to 10 configured databases/account each select, insert, update, delete and schema statement counts toward the daily limit (resets 00:00 utc); over-limit queries fail rather than becoming unlimited. hyperdrive requires a separately operated postgresql/mysql origin and a worker: origin hosting and paid workers resources are not included.

cloudflare-vectorize cloudflare vectorize free databases & caching workers free includes 30 million queried vector dimensions/month and 5 million stored vector dimensions; up to 100 indexes usage is counted in vector dimensions, not simple query count. free supports up to 1,536 dimensions/vector, 1,000 namespaces/index and 10 kib metadata/vector; workers compute and any external embeddings api have separate quotas or costs.

render-postgres render free postgres databases & caching one free render postgres database/workspace, capped at 1 gb; instance expires 30 days after creation free render postgres is a temporary resource: it expires after 30 days, followed by a 14-day grace period before permanent deletion of the database and its data. there are no free backups or managed connection pooling; not suitable for durable production data.

firebase-rtdb firebase realtime database (spark) databases & caching firebase realtime database on spark: 1 gb stored, 10 gb downloaded/month and 100 simultaneous connections spark requires no payment method and does not support multiple realtime database instances in one project. the 10 gb download quota is monthly (blaze uses a different daily free allowance); excess spark usage is restricted rather than silently becoming paid. firebase hosting and other products have separate limits.

cloudflare-r2 cloudflare r2 standard object storage r2 standard: 10 gb-month storage, 1m class a operations and 10m class b operations per month; no egress fee the ongoing monthly free quota applies only to r2 standard storage, not infrequent access (which also has retrieval fees). storage and request usage above the allowance are billed; track billable-unit rounding and avoid confusing free egress with free storage.

gcs google cloud storage free tier object storage 5 gb-months regional cloud storage, 5,000 class a and 50,000 class b operations/month in eligible us regions; up to 100 gb eligible outbound transfer/month storage/operations free tier applies only to us-east1, us-west1 and us-central1, aggregated across these regions. the 100 gb north america outbound allowance excludes destinations in china and australia; not all egress routes are free. billing account/payment method required; unsupported locations, storage classes and overages may be billed.

oracle-object-storage oracle object storage always free object storage oci always free object storage: 20 gb combined standard/infrequent access/archive storage on always free-only accounts and 50,000 object storage api requests/month the 20 gb is shared across storage classes, not 20 gb per class. accounts with paid/trial credits instead get 10 gb each in standard, infrequent access and archive plus 50,000 requests/month. oracle warns objects exceeding the 20 gb always free-only limit may be deleted when the 30-day trial ends without upgrade. oci account/payment verification and home-region restrictions apply.

pr-quorum-free pr quorum free apis & developer tools 50 ai code reviews/month across 2 repositories; max 3 inline comments/review $0 forever, no card, up to 50 monthly pr panel reviews across 2 repositories; three default reviewers and maximum 3 inline comments. at quota exhaustion additional reviews are skipped (not auto-billed); custom panels, higher quotas and byo openrouter key require paid plans.
Astral uv Open-Source Python Package Manager

uv-python-package-manager-local astral uv open-source python package manager apis & developer tools mit/apache-2.0 local python package and project manager with dependency resolution, lockfiles, python version management and cli tool installation; no license fee or per-project quota. this is local mit/apache-2.0 software, not a hosted python development plan. python packages and registries have independent terms; ci runners, private registries, cloud compute and bandwidth can cost money.

estuary-developer estuary developer apis & developer tools free developer tier: up to 10 gb data moved/month and 2 concurrent connector instances; no card required developer is an ongoing free plan, not just a trial. exceeding 10 gb/month or 2 connectors automatically starts a separate 30-day cloud trial; after it ends, a payment method is needed to continue paid cloud pipelines. disable unneeded connectors to avoid subsequent charges.

resend resend free email & notifications resend free: 3,000 transactional emails/month, 100/day, 3 domains and 10,000 automation runs free has a hard daily send cap and 30-day data retention. pay-as-you-go email overages are only available on paid subscriptions, not an automatic unlimited free extension. verify sender domains and deliverability; extra domains, dedicated ips and higher daily limits require paid plans.

better-stack better stack free apis & developer tools free personal projects: 10 monitors/heartbeats, one status page, slack/email alerts; 3 gb logs and 3 gb traces/month retained for 3 days the $0 tier is positioned for personal projects. also includes 100,000 exceptions, 5,000 session replays and 30 gb metrics allowance; longer retention, higher quotas and paid incident responder seats are separate. do not assume the free tier includes unlimited production monitoring or commercial-use rights.

github-actions github actions ci/cd & pipelines github free: $12/month included shared compute allowance (roughly 2,000 linux 2-core runner minutes); standard hosted runners free for public repos the included private-repository allowance is now a dollar-denominated shared compute budget, not a guaranteed 2,000 minutes on every runner os; windows/macos and cloud sandbox usage draw at different rates. public standard hosted runners and self-hosted runners remain free; public larger runners are billable. artifacts/packages share a separate 500 mb free storage allowance; extra use is blocked without a valid payment method or charged when billing is enabled.

neon neon free postgres databases & caching 100 projects; 100 cu-hours/project/month; 1 gb storage/project scale-to-zero after inactivity; 5 gb public network transfer/project/month; verify project eligibility.

prisma-postgres prisma postgres free databases & caching 2 gb storage; 200,000 database operations/month; up to 50 databases; unlimited database data transfer free is $0 forever without a card and has a fixed $0 spend limit (no automatic overage billing). one query counts as one operation; free has 10 pooled and 10 direct connections and no automated backups. paid plans offer larger quotas with spend limits.

cloudflare-kv cloudflare workers kv free databases & caching workers free kv: 1 gb stored, 100k key reads/day and 1k each of key writes, deletes and list requests/day read/write/delete/list limits are separate, reset at 00:00 utc, and exceeding any quota causes that operation to fail. dashboard and wrangler operations count toward limits; missing-key reads also count. no kv egress charge, but workers requests and cpu quotas are separate.

brevo brevo free email & notifications brevo free: 300 emails sent/day and storage for up to 100,000 contacts, with no plan expiry unused daily sends do not roll over. campaigns above 300 recipients require manually requeuing remaining contacts; transactional messages can queue up to 1,000 excess sends. free includes brevo branding, 1 account user, basic reporting and up to 2,000 unique contacts entering automations. paid plan required for higher quotas and advanced features.

github-codespaces github codespaces (personal free) apis & developer tools github free personal accounts: 120 core-hours/month and 15 gb-month codespaces storage organization accounts do not receive this personal free quota. a 2-core machine consumes 2 core-hours per elapsed hour; if no payment method is on file, codespaces usage is blocked when the free quota is exhausted instead of auto-billing. paid overages require a payment method and budget controls.

cloudflare-email-routing cloudflare email routing email & notifications free inbound email forwarding for custom domains on workers free and workers paid; unlimited inbound routed emails email routing is inbound-only; arbitrary outbound email sending requires workers paid. sending to verified destination addresses in your own account is free, but it is not a public transactional sending api. routing via email workers consumes workers usage separately; configure domain dns/email routing correctly.

github-packages github packages apis & developer tools public packages are free; github free includes 500 mb private storage and 1 gb monthly transfer github free includes 500 mb private package storage and 1 gb private package transfer/month. storage is shared with actions artifacts; eligible public packages and current container registry bandwidth are separately free. above-limit private usage can be charged unless budgets/usage controls prevent it; plan reset applies to transfer.

doppler-developer doppler developer authentication & security 3 users free; 5 config syncs; 3 days of activity logs the ongoing developer tier includes 3 users, 5 config syncs and 3-day audit activity logs. each extra developer is $8/month. the separate team tier has an introductory 14-day premium trial; do not classify that trial as expiry of developer free.

auth0 auth0 free authentication & security auth0 free: up to 25k monthly active users, 5 organizations, 1 custom domain and 1 enterprise connection no credit card is needed to sign up for free, but custom domains require card verification. free includes limited tenant and connection features; higher production limits and additional organizations are on paid plans. mau quota is not an unlimited user allowance.

clerk clerk hobby authentication & security clerk hobby free: 50k monthly retained users (mru) per application, unlimited applications, up to 3 dashboard seats mru counts retained users, not the same as monthly active users (mau). hobby needs no card; it has 1-day application-log retention, fixed 7-day sessions and limited impersonation. b2b add-on free supports 100 monthly retained organizations with up to 20 members each; paid sso/advanced controls are separate.

cloudflare-turnstile cloudflare turnstile free authentication & security up to 20 free turnstile widgets/account; 10 configured hostnames/widget and unlimited verification challenges turnstile free can protect production websites, including small and medium businesses, independently of other cloudflare services. analytics lookback is limited to 7 days. custom-branding removal, any-hostname widgets and ephemeral ids are enterprise-only; free supports pre-clearance.

new-relic-free new relic free monitoring & observability new relic free: 100 gb data ingest/month, one full-platform user, unlimited basic users and 500 synthetic monitoring checks no credit card needed for the perpetual free edition. default data retention is at least 8 days, varying by data type; data ingest stops when free exceeds its monthly 100 gb allowance until next month or upgrade. additional full-platform seats and ingest beyond 100 gb on paid editions are billable.

uptimerobot uptimerobot free monitoring & observability 50 monitors with 5-minute checks and basic status pages free checks run every 5 minutes; 60-second checks and advanced alerts require a paid plan. basic status pages and integrations have limitations. the free plan is eligible for personal and commercial monitoring under uptimerobot's fair use policy.

grafana-cloud grafana cloud free monitoring & observability grafana cloud free: 10,000 active metric series/month and 50 gb logs ingested/month, with 14-day free retention no credit card for ongoing free, but metrics, logs, traces, profiles and synthetic tests have separate usage caps. free retention is 14 days for metrics, logs and traces; pro starts with a $19/month platform fee plus usage. do not mistake self-hosted grafana oss for free managed ingestion.

sentry sentry developer monitoring & observability one user; 5,000 errors/month; 50 replays and 1 uptime monitor developer is $0 for one user with error/tracing support; extra seats, event volume, profiling and paid integrations are separate. a temporary new-user promotion grants 5,000 session replays/month for the first 3 months; it does not expand the ongoing free allowance.

splunk-observability-free splunk observability cloud free edition monitoring & observability splunk observability cloud free edition: agent observability for agentic applications and supporting infrastructure, up to 15 hosts, without a fixed trial period free edition concentrates on agent observability and up to 15 hosts, not every paid observability cloud module. sign-up may require a request and platform eligibility; throttling and 30-day inactivity deactivation can apply. commercial usage is restricted to internal business purposes; no service-bureau use.

tinybird-free tinybird free product analytics 10 gb storage; 1,000 requests/day per organization; 0.25 vcpu (up to 3x burst); 1 query thread the ongoing free plan includes shared query infrastructure (0.25 vcpu with bursts), a 10-second query execution ceiling and one query thread; bursts over capacity can yield 429 errors. separately advertised llm credits are not recurring general-purpose database cash credit.

posthog posthog free product analytics posthog free: 1m product analytics events/month, 5,000 session recordings/month and 1m feature-flag requests/month the $0 free plan has no credit-card requirement and renews monthly; quotas are independent per product. without billing enabled, excess events are dropped and feature flags fall back to quota-limited behavior; adding a card moves to usage-based billing with paid overages. free plan allows one project and one-year retention.

cloudflare-dns cloudflare dns & cdn free dns & cdn free authoritative dns, cdn, universal ssl and ddos protection free provides authoritative dns, basic cdn, universal ssl and ddos protections for eligible zones; the free cdn is not website hosting. zones created after september 2024 have lower record-count defaults (check the currently applicable dns record cap); advanced performance/waf features may require paid plans.

hf-static-spaces hugging face static spaces ai & ml platforms free static html/javascript spaces hosted on hugging face for demos, portfolios and ml interfaces, without managed runtime compute static spaces are free for everyone. creating cpu-backed gradio/docker compute spaces normally requires a paid account tier, even though cpu basic hardware itself lists a zero hourly rate; limited eligible zerogpu exceptions exist. gpus, model inference and persistent compute are not part of this static tier.

gemini-api google gemini developer api free ai & ml platforms free input and output tokens for eligible gemini models; google ai studio access gemini developer api free eligibility, per-model token billing and rate limits vary by current model, geography and request mode. no broad promise of unlimited free api use; free-tier content may be used to improve google products. cloud billing is separate for paid-tier access.

cloudflare-workers-ai cloudflare workers ai free ai & ml platforms 10,000 workers ai neurons/day across eligible inference models (resets daily at 00:00 utc) free neuron allowance covers only eligible workers ai models; requests above it fail until reset or upgrade to workers paid, which bills excess neurons. some frontier models require workers paid or prepaid ai gateway credits even before daily free allocation is exhausted. standard workers request/cpu quotas also apply.

aiven-postgres aiven free postgresql databases & caching one ongoing free aiven postgresql service per organization: single node, 1 cpu, 1 gb ram and 1 gb disk; no credit card required no vpc, static ip, service integrations, connection pooling, sla or aiven support; maximum 20 concurrent database connections. free services have no fixed expiry but may be powered off after sustained inactivity and can be restarted; upgrading to paid requires a payment method.

appwrite-cloud appwrite cloud free backend & app hosting appwrite cloud free: 2 projects, 5 gb monthly bandwidth, 2 gb storage, 750,000 executions/month and 75,000 monthly active users free includes one database, one bucket and two functions per project; projects pause after one week of inactivity. backups, extra resources and production-oriented features require paid tiers; do not mistake the $10 pro compute credit for free recurring usage.

gitlab-ci gitlab ci/cd free ci/cd & pipelines 400 compute minutes/month per gitlab.com free top-level namespace on eligible gitlab-hosted instance runners minutes are calculated as job duration multiplied by the runner/project cost factor and shared across the namespace. when the monthly quota is exhausted, additional hosted-runner jobs can be blocked; purchased extra compute and storage are separate. self-managed runners use your own infrastructure.

cloudflare-queues cloudflare queues free queues, workflows & scheduling cloudflare queues on workers free: 10,000 standard operations/day, 24-hour non-configurable message retention a message delivery normally consumes 3 operations (write, read, delete), with additional reads for retries and extra operations for payloads over 64 kb. queue operations are not a 10,000-messages/day guarantee; workers free usage has separate limits. message retention is fixed to 24 hours on free, unlike configurable paid.

upstash-qstash upstash qstash free queues, workflows & scheduling upstash qstash free: 1,000 message delivery attempts/day, 50 gb bandwidth/month, 10 active schedules and 1 mb messages each delivery attempt—including retries—counts against the daily quota; one topic publish costs a delivery per subscribed endpoint. free includes maximum 7-day delay, 3-day logs/dlq retention and 10 concurrent deliveries; paid plans increase quotas. do not confuse published jobs with billed delivery attempts.

upstash-workflow upstash workflow free queues, workflows & scheduling upstash workflow free: 1,000 billed steps/day, 50 gb bandwidth/month, 10 concurrent steps and 1 mb message size a retry counts as another step; context.call/context.invoke each cost two billed steps and parallel execution incurs extra steps. free workflow sleep is limited to 7 days, log/dlq retention to 3 days; persistent daily quota overruns can cause workflow failures via qstash. not unlimited serverless compute.

cron-job-org cron-job.org free queues, workflows & scheduling free scheduled http requests as frequently as every minute; no fixed job-count limit under fair use the service is fully free for regular http cron jobs under fair-use requirements. jobs call publicly reachable urls; very high scheduling volume or rest api use is rate limited. your own target endpoint/cloud provider may still incur compute or network costs.

cloudflare-workflows cloudflare workflows free queues, workflows & scheduling workers free includes 3,000 workflow steps/day and 1 gb-month of state storage; invocations share the workers free requests quota workflow steps, state storage, worker invocations and cpu are separate usage dimensions; 10 ms cpu per invocation on free and the workers free daily request cap apply. default completed/errored workflow state retention is 3 days. workflow sleeps/waits do not consume cpu, and workflows billing began august 10, 2026; paid has separate metered charges.

tinyfish-search-fetch tinyfish search & fetch hosted search search: 30 requests/min and 500/hour; fetch: 150 urls/min and 1,000/day search and fetch remain free within published rate limits even with a $0 wallet; agent and browser are separate prepaid metered products. a new signup wallet promotional grant is one-time, not recurring search/fetch credit. no card needed for the free search/fetch apis.

algolia-free algolia free search hosted search 10k searches/month; 50k records; 5k recommendation requests and 5k crawls/month the standalone free plan has fixed search/record/recommendation/crawl limits, no card requirement, and can be used for commercial production sites; grow and grow plus are distinct metered plans that can bill for overages. confirm the plan before enabling paid usage.

upstash-search upstash search free hosted search one ongoing upstash search free database: 20,000 search queries/month and up to 200,000 records free is a distinct capped database tier. adding a credit card upgrades the database to pay-as-you-go ($0.05 per 1,000 billed search/upsert requests), where the free query cap no longer applies; no automatic unlimited free usage. pro/enterprise trials offered on request are separate from this ongoing free plan.

flagsmith flagsmith free feature flags & gradual rollout 50,000 flag api requests/month; one team member and one project; unlimited feature flags free cloud is limited to 50,000 counted api requests/month and 1 team member; fair-use terms apply. if free exceeds its monthly limit, flagsmith allows 7 days to upgrade before action is taken; do not assume unlimited free overage. additional team members, scheduling and a/b testing require paid plans.

openfeature-kubernetes-operator-self-hosted openfeature kubernetes operator (self-hosted) feature flags & gradual rollout apache-2.0 open-source kubernetes operator for feature flags, injecting flagd sidecars and exposing flag evaluation via grpc and http; no software license fee or vendor quota. requires a user-operated kubernetes cluster and flagd sidecars; infrastructure and monitoring are not free. the operator resolves cross-namespace resources, with documented multi-tenant isolation risk ghsa-398h-7f66-3h4p; apply upstream mitigations.

launchdarkly-developer launchdarkly developer feature flags & gradual rollout unlimited seats and feature flags; five service connections; 1,000 client-side mau/month developer is $0/month with no card required, limited to 5 service connections and 1,000 client-side mau/month; additional paid entitlements and advanced capabilities belong to foundation/enterprise plans. commercial-use eligibility beyond the published developer terms remains unconfirmed.

upstash-blob upstash blob free object storage one upstash blob free bucket: 1 gb monthly-average storage, 10 gb outbound bandwidth, 10,000 simple and 2,000 advanced operations/month free quotas are hard caps: the bucket stops serving requests until the rolling 30-day window resets, with no free-plan overage charge. adding a credit card switches to pay-as-you-go billed from the first byte/operation, with no continuing free allowance. reads/metadata lookups are simple operations; uploads, copies and listings are advanced; deletes are free.

weaviate-cloud-free weaviate cloud free databases & caching one always-free weaviate cloud shared cluster/user: 100,000 objects, 1 gb ram, 10 gb disk, one collection and up to three tenants no card required. free separately includes 2,000 weaviate embeddings requests/day and 1,000 query agent requests/month; backups, ha/replication and production sla are not included. paid flex and other ai-service overages are separate; do not assume all query/embedding usage is unlimited.

inngest-hobby inngest hobby queues, workflows & scheduling inngest cloud free: 50,000 executions/month, 500,000 events/month, 5 concurrent steps, 5 seats and 3 workers no card required. a single function run and every step execution each consume one execution (five steps use six executions). free includes 100,000 queue depth, 50 concurrent realtime connections and 24-hour trace/log history; function runs can sleep for at most 30 days. extra compute/sandbox resources may be billed separately.

trigger-dev-free trigger.dev free queues, workflows & scheduling $5 recurring compute/run credits each month on trigger.dev free ($0/month); 20 concurrent runs, 10 schedules, unlimited tasks and 5 team members the $5 free compute/run credit renews monthly; it is not a one-time trial. free includes dev/prod environments, 10 concurrent realtime connections and one-day log and query retention. usage beyond credit may require an upgrade; hobby is a separately billed $10/month plan with its own included credits.

qdrant-cloud-free qdrant cloud free databases & caching one ongoing free single-node qdrant cloud cluster with 0.5 vcpu, 1 gb ram and 4 gb disk; no credit card required free is for prototyping, not production: limited cloud/region choice and no high availability or production sla. cluster suspends after one week of inactivity and is deleted after four weeks unless reactivated; snapshots must be managed manually. free hosted qdrant is separate from self-hosted oss and paid inference.

cloudflare-durable-objects cloudflare durable objects free serverless & edge workers free durable objects: 100,000 requests/day, 13,000 gb-seconds duration/day and up to 5 gb total sqlite-backed storage only sqlite-backed durable objects can be created on workers free; key-value-backed objects are unavailable. sqlite storage has additional daily row-read/write limits (5m reads and 100k writes), and free limits reset at 00:00 utc; exceeding them causes errors. workers request and cpu quotas also apply.

circleci-free circleci free ci/cd & pipelines up to 6,000 build minutes/month on a small docker resource; up to 5 active users build-minute consumption varies by resource class and credit rate; higher-resource jobs exhaust the free allowance sooner. paid plans offer additional credits.

crow-ci crow ci ci/cd & pipelines apache-2.0 open-source ci/cd for self-hosted pipelines; no software-enforced build-minute or pipeline-run quotas, with docker, podman, kubernetes and other agent backends. self-hosted only: provide and pay for your own servers/runners, storage and networking; capacity and costs depend on your infrastructure. no managed free runner allowance is included.

val-town-free val town free backend & app hosting val town free: 100,000 val runs/day, unlimited public vals, up to 2,500 vals and cron schedules no more frequently than every 15 minutes free vals are public (no private vals), each run has a one-minute wall-clock timeout and logs are retained for three days. custom domains, external email recipients, 1-minute cron schedules and longer runtimes require paid pro; ongoing free is not a short-term trial.

simpleq simpleq free queues, workflows & scheduling 30,000 outbound webhook attempts/month; 5 queues; up to 5 attempts/job; 3-day job retention free has 30,000 monthly outbound webhook post attempts across five queues, no card and no paid overage. retry attempts count toward the cap; backpressure waiting does not. at the limit you must upgrade rather than assuming unlimited delivery; job retention is three days.

ngrok-free ngrok free tunneling & networking ngrok free: 3 online endpoints, up to 1 gb monthly data transfer, 20,000 http(s) requests/month, 5,000 tcp/tls connections/month and $5 one-time included usage the $5 included usage is a one-time credit, not a recurring $5/month allowance. free http(s) endpoints show an interstitial page; no additional usage beyond credit is allowed. free tcp endpoints require card verification (no charge for verification); assigned development domains differ from paid branded/custom domains. do not treat a one-time credit as a time-limited free plan.

windmill-cloud-free windmill cloud community queues, workflows & scheduling 1,000 cloud executions/month; no credit card required hosted windmill cloud community has an ongoing bounded monthly execution allocation and is distinct from a separately self-hosted community edition. cloud service limits and regions are provider-operated; personal/commercial use and paid extras should be checked against the latest cloud terms.

axiom-personal axiom personal monitoring & observability 500 gb data loading/month; 10 gb-hours query compute/month; 25 gb storage; 30-day retention axiom personal is a permanent $0 hosted plan with no credit card: 500 gb monthly data loading, 10 gb-hours query compute, 25 gb storage and 30-day retention, for individual developers and small projects. the separate axiom cloud plan adds a $25/month platform fee and larger allowances.

hookdeck-developer hookdeck developer webhooks & event delivery 10,000 events/month; 100,000 discarded requests/month; 5 events/second per destination; 3-day event retention developer is an ongoing $0 plan with 10,000 monthly events, one user, three-day retention and five events/second/destination. one inbound request may create multiple events; retries are included. after 10,000 events the dashboard locks until renewal or upgrade; excessive overages may stop processing. paid team/growth use separate metered billing.

svix-free svix free webhooks & event delivery up to 50,000 messages/month; 50 messages/second; 7-day payload retention free requires no credit card, with 50 messages/second, 7-day payload retention and no stated uptime sla. the 200 messages/second limit, 30-day retention and 99.9% uptime sla are paid basic features. check payload-size and retry accounting before high-volume use.

tailscale-personal tailscale personal tunneling & networking up to 6 users; unlimited user devices; 50 tagged resources; 1,000 ephemeral-resource minutes/month free personal is for non-commercial home/personal use only; work-domain or business use may enter a 14-day enterprise trial and require a paid plan. additional tagged resources and higher ephemeral limits have separate charges.

pinecone-starter pinecone starter databases & caching pinecone starter: up to 2 gb vector storage, 2 million write units and 1 million read units/month, 1 gb egress/month and 5 indexes starter is a recurring free managed database allowance, limited to aws us-east-1, one project and small teams, without an uptime sla. dedicated read nodes, backups and cross-region restore are unavailable; builder ($20/month) and higher usage-based plans are distinct. inference or assistant resources can have separate limits.

motherduck-lite motherduck lite databases & caching 10 gb storage and 10 pulse compute cu-hours/month; up to 3 internal active users and 2 service accounts lite is an ongoing $0 tier with 10 gb storage and 10 hours of pulse compute/month; a card is not needed. an optional 7-day business trial is separate and does not terminate the free lite plan. customer-facing embedding/redistribution is restricted on lite; usage beyond lite included quotas needs a paid plan.

openstatus-hobby openstatus hobby monitoring & observability ongoing $0 hobby plan with 1 uptime monitor, 1 status page containing 3 components and minimum check interval of 10 minutes new workspaces start on a separate 14-day starter trial with no card, then return to ongoing hobby if not upgraded. hobby needs no credit card; 1-minute checks, additional monitors, larger status pages and advanced alerting options are paid. do not classify the trial's 14-day expiry as expiry of the hobby free plan.

cloudflare-browser-run cloudflare browser run free apis & developer tools 10 minutes total browser execution time/day on workers free; 3 concurrent browser sessions/account the daily 10-minute browser run allowance is shared by quick actions and browser sessions. new browser sessions are limited to one every 20 seconds; browser timeout is 60 seconds and quick actions are capped at 1 request every 10 seconds. /crawl additionally permits 5 crawl jobs/day and up to 100 pages/job on free; paid usage has separate charges.

kinsta-wordpress-trial kinsta wordpress first month backend & app hosting first month free for eligible new customers on select managed wordpress plans; single 20gb includes 1 wordpress install, 20 gb server bandwidth/month, 10 gb storage and 125 gb cdn bandwidth/month. a time-limited first-month promotional offer, not an ongoing free plan. single 20gb is $0 for the first month then $35/month on monthly billing, excluding taxes. new-customer and plan eligibility, automatic renewal, payment method and cancellation terms must be checked before signup.

sevalla-static sevalla static site hosting static & frontend hosting sevalla static site hosting: 100 static sites/account, 600 build minutes/month, 100 gb bandwidth/month and 1 gb/site maximum the static-site tier is free under provider fair-use limits; application/database hosting is paid after a separate trial, not included in this free static plan. one concurrent build/site; usage beyond the free bandwidth/build quotas may scale into billable resources. confirm payment requirements before enabling paid usage.

shipvela-hobby shipvela free static hosting static & frontend hosting 3 projects; 20 publishes/month; custom domains and managed https this is shipvela free ($0), not the separate paid hobby tier ($9.99/month). free publishing resets monthly and has no automatic overage charges. prebuilt cli uploads are limited to 50 mb/5,000 files; supported next.js ssr requires paid pro/studio. domain registration, databases and backend services are not included.

novu-free novu free email & notifications 10,000 workflow runs/month on novu cloud free; up to 20 workflows, 2 environments (dev/prod), 3 team members and all notification channels no credit card required. free activity-feed retention is 24 hours and event trigger throughput is limited to 60/sec. free includes us/eu data residency; removing novu branding, seven-day retention and increased workflow throughput require a paid plan. email/sms delivery providers may charge separately.

webhooker-free webhooker free webhooks & event delivery 10,000 inbound events/month; 3 sources; 9 shared destinations; 1 workspace member; 14-day event retention free has 10,000 inbound events/month, three sources, nine destinations and 14-day retention, without a signup card. rate limit is 120 incoming events/minute/source; a 20% buffer avoids immediate paid overage. higher-volume production features, ordered delivery, static egress ip and dpa need a paid plan.

featureflip-solo featureflip solo feature flags & gradual rollout 1 project; 10 flags; 2 environments; 1 developer; unlimited evaluations free is permanent without a credit card or trial deadline: 1 project, 10 flags, 2 environments, up to 3 team members and 7-day audit logs. paid tiers unlock larger teams, more projects/environments, scheduled changes and longer audit history.

appsignal-free appsignal free monitoring & observability ongoing free: 30,000 app requests/month, 1 gb logging and 5-day retention existing free users' grandfathered 50,000 requests/month allowance ends on october 31, 2026; afterward the free tier is 30,000 requests/month. crossing the request or logging limit locks the ui/api and disables notifications rather than generating overage invoices. a limited-term paid upgrade discount is not an ongoing free allowance.

honeycomb-free honeycomb free monitoring & observability 20 million events/month; 100 million metrics data points/month; unlimited seats; unlimited querying free forever includes 2 triggers, distributed tracing and bubbleup. service level objectives require pro; service map is enterprise-only. free event/metric ingestion is capped; commercial-use terms are not explicitly confirmed.

flagify-free flagify free feature flags & gradual rollout 2 projects/workspace; unlimited flags; 3 environments; 3 seats; 75,000 evaluations/month; 50 ai messages/month ongoing free ($0, no card) is limited to one workspace, two projects, three environments, three seats, 75,000 evaluations/month and 50 ai messages/month. higher quotas, audit logs, rbac and full api access belong to paid plans. the advertised $20 per 1m extra evaluations is an additional paid-usage rate, not an included free allowance; confirm overage enforcement before relying on a hard stop.

reqkey-free reqkey apis & developer tools 5,000,000 requests/month; 1,000 api keys; unlimited apis; 1 workspace member a billable-meter request means one api key validation or one logged api call; using both can consume two units for the same application request. free traffic is not hard-stopped immediately above the allowance, but the provider may request a tier upgrade for sustained overuse; its pricing faq says over-allowance accepted traffic is not retroactively billed. no credit card required.

logtrics-free logtrics monitoring & observability 1,000,000 logs/crashes/events per month; 30-day retention; 1 app; 1 team member; email alerts; 3 ai rca and 3 ai session summaries per month free is limited to 1 app, 1 team member, 30-day retention, and 3 ai rca plus 3 ai session summaries per month. provider pricing says it notifies users approaching the 1m monthly log/event quota and offers paid extra log capacity at $10 per 50m logs/month; it does not establish a guaranteed hard stop for free. confirm over-quota enforcement before relying on it for production cost protection; do not assume paid capacity is automatically purchased on free.

mockhive-free mockhive free testing & qa 3 collections with 100 records each; 1,000 get requests/month; 50 post inserts/day; 3 ai api builder uses/month free is $0 forever without a card. production base urls and relationships require starter; when a quota is exhausted, further mock requests can return http 429 until upgrade or the billing cycle resets.

devcycle-free devcycle free feature flags & gradual rollout 1,000 client-side maus; 10,000 cloud config requests/month; 100,000 server config requests/month; 5,000 events/month; unlimited feature flags and seats client-side maus count unique client sdk initializations, while cloud-bucketing requests, server sdk configuration fetches and events have separate quotas. free has no credit card requirement. paid business features and overages are separate; the pricing page does not clearly specify free over-quota behavior, so do not assume unlimited calls or automatic billing.

datpaq-free datpaq free apis & developer tools 250 api requests/month; full api catalog, cli and mcp server free remains $0 without a card for 250 api requests/month. official pricing faq says usage above the monthly limit receives an approximately five-day upgrade grace window; requests over the limit may be billed after that. do not assume an automatic hard stop; confirm actual billing enforcement with datpaq before production use.

datanest-free datanest basic free apis & developer tools 100 requests/month per api across 20 apis free basic is a hard stop at 100 requests/month per api, without a paid overage. paid rapidapi tiers use soft quotas and bill additional requests per call; commercial use is explicitly permitted even on free.

mastra-starter mastra platform starter ai & ml platforms 100,000 observability events/month; 24 cpu hours/month; 10 gb data egress/month; 15-day data retention; unlimited users, projects and deployments starter is $0/month but usage above monthly allowances is pay-as-you-go: $10/100k observability events, $0.35/cpu hour and $0.10/gb egress. set credit top-up/auto-top-up cautiously; a persistent always-on server is $100/project. model/gateway tokens, storage and other metered services have separate charges. card requirement and commercial-use terms remain unconfirmed.

growthbook-starter growthbook cloud starter feature flags & gradual rollout 3 users, 1 project, unlimited feature flags, experiments and traffic; optional managed warehouse includes 1 million events/month cloud starter is free without a card. bring-your-own data warehouse may have separate infrastructure charges; advanced ai visual editor, governance and multi-project features require pro. the self-hosted open source edition is separate.

hook0-developer hook0 developer free webhooks & event delivery 100 webhook events/day; 10 event types; 10 subscriptions; 1 application and 1 developer; 7-day event retention extra events on the hosted developer free plan are blocked with http 429, not automatically billed. retries, hmac signing and delivery logs are included. separately offered sspl-1.0 self-hosted hook0 requires your own infrastructure; this listing is for the managed cloud developer plan. no credit card required.

pingzen-free pingzen free monitoring & observability 55 monitors; 1-minute checks; 23 protocols; telegram/email/webhook alerts plus 3 saved integrations; 5 status pages, 20 alerts, 5 api keys and 3 team members free forever without a card and explicitly permitted for commercial sites. three consecutive failed checks are required by default before an alert (typically 2–3 minutes); service is provided as-is without uptime sla or compensation.

zenmanage-free zenmanage free feature flags & gradual rollout 500 monthly active contexts; unlimited flags, projects and users permanent free tier includes 500 monthly active contexts and unlimited projects, users and flags, without a card. the separate 30-day team trial does not make free time-limited. hosted mcp/management api, audit logs and advanced lifecycle reporting require paid plans.

steadystack-initiate steadystack the initiate monitoring & observability 50 monitors; 3-minute checks (1 minute for first 10); 1 public status page the initiate is grandfathered to eligible early launch-cohort accounts: official pricing promises to honor launch terms permanently for early accounts, not unrestricted access to this $0 allowance for new signups. the separate 14-day trial applies to paid plans and does not make this ongoing legacy allowance a time-limited trial. free retains logs for 3 days and includes one steadystack-branded public status page; official pricing explicitly permits commercial use and says no credit card is required to start.
botoi-free botoi free apis & developer tools 1,000 api requests/day; 10 requests/minute; 150+ endpoints and mcp server 429 responses on quota exhaustion; resets midnight utc

dbgorilla-free dbgorilla free databases & caching 1 single-host cluster; 50 gorilla credits/month; 7-day retention the initial 30-day pro trial automatically reverts to ongoing free (1 single-host cluster, 50 monthly gorilla credits) unless upgraded. free monthly credits reset and do not roll over. credit-pack auto-reload is on by default in provider pricing documentation; disable auto-reload explicitly to pause credit-consuming actions at zero balance and avoid unexpected purchased credits. a local read-only collector sends telemetry to the managed cloud; fully on-prem deployment is enterprise, not free.

checkly-hobby checkly hobby monitoring & observability 10 uptime monitors; 1,000 browser check runs and 10,000 api check runs/month; 1 user; 7-day raw data retention hobby is an ongoing $0 plan for personal projects and learning; no credit card required. its 10,000 api and 1,000 browser check runs per month are hard capped: checks stop running once the relevant credits are exhausted, rather than generating paid overages. one user, 7-day raw result retention and 30-day aggregated retention. on paid starter/team, checks continue past prepaid allowances and overage rates apply.

formbricks-hobby formbricks cloud hobby forms & surveys 250 survey responses/month; 1 workspace; link and in-product surveys; full api access including mcp this is the provider-hosted formbricks cloud hobby tier, not the separately self-hosted community edition. hobby includes 250 responses/month, one workspace and formbricks branding; the full api (including mcp) is included. the paid pro tier advertises optional dynamic response-overage handling, which must not be assumed available or automatically billable on hobby. credit-card and commercial-use terms beyond published plan details should not be inferred.

botkeep-free botkeep free backend & app hosting 1 server slot for new signups; 512 mb ram; 0.5 shared vcore (50% cpu); 1 gb storage; 24/7 operation without scheduled idle sleep or periodic manual renewal standard free for new signups is one server, not the older two-slot allocation. the provider explicitly states existing accounts keep their previously assigned conditions; this does not make the current one-server free plan existing-users-only. capacity, fair-use and beta availability rules apply; 24/7 is not an uptime sla. backups are subject to assigned plan limits and provider faq says automatic age-based deletion is not currently enabled; keep independent backups. paid resources are separate. commercial-use permission remains unconfirmed.

hanko-cloud-starter-free hanko cloud starter free authentication & security 10,000 monthly active users; 2 projects; passkeys, passwords/passwordless, social sso, mfa, custom domain hosted in aws frankfurt; webhooks, admin api, custom smtp and team invites require pro; repeated overage prompts upgrade. commercial-use terms for cloud free not independently confirmed.

suprsend-free suprsend free email & notifications 10,000 notifications/month; unlimited notification channels and team members; in-app feed, workflow branching, lists and broadcasts 30-day premium-feature trial transitions to ongoing free; suprsend branding on in-app feed; multi-channel delivery counts each user/channel separately; email/sms providers may charge separately; free over-limit sends may continue pending contact from suprsend; explicit commercial-use terms not confirmed.

cloady cloady free backend & app hosting 0.5 vcpu, 1 gb ram and 5 gb persistent ssd shared by apps in a workspace; 200 gb traffic no guaranteed service level; one subscription covers every region, but phone/sms verification is required once per account before dashboard/api access. exceeding any free resource threshold makes the full workspace capacity billable, not just the excess; a payment method is required to deploy paid resources. optional managed backups cost extra; commercial-use and idle-expiry terms should be confirmed.

jsdelivr-open-source-cdn jsdelivr open source cdn apis & developer tools free cdn for open-source npm and github files; no bandwidth or request limits under permitted use not general-purpose image, video, backup, or file hosting; must comply with source-platform terms and jsdelivr acceptable-use restrictions.

imagekit-forever-free imagekit forever free object storage 20 gb delivery bandwidth/month; 3 gb dam storage; 500 video units/month; 2 users; 500 purge requests/month delivery stops at the monthly bandwidth cap; uploads stop at storage cap; no custom domain included; commercial-use terms and card requirement need confirmation.

cloudinary-free cloudinary free object storage 25 credits per rolling 30 days shared across transformations, storage and bandwidth; 3 users 1 credit equals 1,000 transformations or 1 gb storage or 1 gb delivery; combined usage counts toward 25-credit allowance. exceeding limits may disable service after warnings.

claude-free claude free ai chatbots & assistants free ai chat on web and mobile; writing, web search, files and code capabilities with variable usage limits message and model limits vary with demand and reset windows; claude code and higher limits require paid plan. commercial-use permissions for free need confirmation.

chatgpt-free chatgpt free ai chatbots & assistants free ai chat, web search and limited access to file uploads, image tools and data analysis message and tool limits vary; higher usage and advanced capabilities require paid plans. consumer free is not an api credit tier.

gemini-app-free google gemini app free ai chatbots & assistants free gemini app with google account; ai chat, image creation, gemini live and limited deep research model and feature access varies by region and changes with demand; paid google ai plans offer higher usage. not the gemini developer api.

perplexity-standard-free perplexity standard free ai chatbots & assistants practically unlimited basic searches with citations; limited pro searches and basic file uploads advanced models, image generation and premium features require paid plans; pro search quotas can change. commercial-use eligibility must be checked.

laragon-free laragon free (non-commercial) apis & developer tools free local development environment for personal and non-commercial use. commercial use requires a paid license; confirm current laragon license terms before business use.

gitkraken-community gitkraken desktop community apis & developer tools free git client for local and public repositories. private repositories and advanced features require a paid plan; verify plan restrictions.

tally-forms-free tally forms free forms & surveys unlimited forms and submissions under fair-use guidelines; webhooks and file uploads up to 10 mb per file. tally branding remains; custom domains, team collaboration and larger uploads require paid plans. fair-use restrictions apply; commercial-use terms unconfirmed.

duckdns-free duck dns free dns & cdn free dynamic dns subdomains under duckdns.org with ipv4/ipv6 updates using https. hostname quota, payment-card requirements and commercial-use terms not confirmed; verify account limits before relying on the service.

pipedream-connect-development pipedream connect free (development) apis & developer tools free development and testing access to connect apis, sdks, mcp and 3,000+ api connectors; no credit card required. development only: production deployment and serving external users require the paid startup plan or higher. do not confuse this with free production workflow hosting.

tigris-object-storage-free tigris object storage free object storage 5 gb standard storage/month; 10,000 class a (put/copy/post/list) and 100,000 class b (get/select/other) requests/month; zero egress fees. free storage covers standard tier only. usage beyond the allowance is billed; object notifications cost $0.01/1,000 events. other storage tiers have separate retrieval fees or minimum retention periods.
mailtrap-email-api-free mailtrap email api/smtp free email & notifications up to 4,000 emails per month and 150 emails per day. one sending domain, one user and 3 days of logs; not unlimited email.
baserow-cloud-free baserow cloud free databases & caching 3,000 rows and 2 gb storage per workspace; 2,000 automation credits. usage and automation limits apply; verify account restrictions.
formspree-free formspree free forms & surveys 50 form submissions per month, unlimited forms and projects. intended for testing and development; 30-day submission archive; no file uploads.
healthchecks-hobbyist healthchecks.io hobbyist monitoring & observability monitor up to 20 scheduled jobs with 100 log entries per job. check alerting and retention limitations before production use.
instatus-starter instatus starter monitoring & observability 15 monitors, two-minute checks, email alerts and public status page. no custom domain; limited subscribers and on-call members.
loops-free loops free email & notifications up to 1,000 contacts and 4,000 emails per 30 days. free-plan branding; transactional and marketing sends share the allowance.
langfuse-hobby langfuse cloud hobby ai & ml platforms 50,000 usage units per month, 30-day data access and two users. usage limits and short history retention; no credit card required.
emailoctopus-starter emailoctopus starter free email & notifications 2,500 subscribers and 10,000 emails per month. branding on emails; 30-day reporting; one landing page and one form.
web3forms-free web3forms free forms & surveys 250 form submissions per month with unlimited forms and domains. paid plan required for additional features and larger submission volume.
cronitor-hacker cronitor hacker free monitoring & observability five monitors, email and slack alerts, and a basic status page. no sms alerts or premium integrations; intended for small projects.

glitchtip-hosted-free glitchtip hosted free monitoring & observability up to 1,000 events per month with unlimited projects and team members. personal projects; usage capped at 1,000 events per month.

infisical-secrets-free infisical secrets management free authentication & security five identities, unlimited projects and 100+ integrations. designed for individuals and personal projects; verify business usage terms.

uploadthing-2gb-app uploadthing 2gb app object storage 2 gb shared storage across apps, unlimited uploads and downloads, and 7-day audit-log retention on the $0/month 2gb app. 2 gb storage is shared across all apps, not 2 gb per app. private files, configurable regions and longer audit logs require paid tiers. provider pricing does not clearly state signup card requirements or commercial-use permission; verify before use.

jitterflow-developer jitterflow developer webhooks & event delivery 10,000 webhooks/month; 5 requests/second; 3 endpoints; 256 kb payloads 3-day dead-letter queue and payload log retention; hard monthly cap; side projects and low-volume production.

dipsac-free dipsac free api apis & developer tools 500 api requests/month; 2 requests/second; 5 mb files; 1 api key the 500-request monthly api quota is separate from unlimited browser tools. the pricing comparison also lists limited free ai voice studio usage (20 speech/transcription generations per day, 1,000 characters per take, 3 minutes per file); do not claim all audio/video features are excluded or that paid video transcription is included. api quota exhaustion returns http 429; unused monthly api requests do not roll over. commercial-use rights are unconfirmed.

railhook-cloud-free railhook cloud free webhooks & event delivery 10,000 events/month; 3 projects; 5 endpoints/project; 7-day history requests over monthly quota are rejected; hosted cloud commercial-use terms unconfirmed.

belmo-starter belmo starter backend & app hosting 1 always-on service; 0.5 shared vcpu; 512 mb ram; ssl; 30-day logs no custom domain on starter, only belmo.io subdomain; commercial terms unconfirmed.

atlassian-statuspage-free atlassian statuspage free monitoring & observability up to 2 public pages per organization; 100 subscribers, 25 components, 2 team members, 2 metrics; email/slack/teams notifications and rate-limited rest api free plan is only for public status pages; private pages and custom domains require paid plans. credit-card requirement and commercial-use terms not independently confirmed.

helicone-hobby helicone hobby ai & ml platforms 10,000 requests/month; 1 gb storage; 1 seat and 1 organization; 7-day data retention free tier ingests up to 10 logs/minute; api access, alerts, and longer retention require paid plans. homepage mentions a 7-day trial for premium features; card requirement and commercial-use rights for hobby need confirmation.

rollbar-free rollbar free monitoring & observability 5,000 error occurrences/month; 1,000 session replays/month; 30-day data retention; unlimited users and projects 14-day advanced trial is separate from the ongoing free tier; 0 ai credits on free; processing stops at the monthly limit by default.

snyk-free snyk free authentication & security 5 projects; monthly limits: 200 open source tests, 100 code tests, 300 iac tests and 100 container tests designed for individual developers and small teams; private-repository scan quotas are enforced and recurring free-plan scans run weekly; commercial-use terms not explicitly confirmed.

permit-community-free permit.io community authentication & security 1,000 monthly active users; 20 tenants; unlimited authorization queries; 3 environments; 25 roles community is free forever for up to 1,000 mau and 20 tenants. the 14-day audit-log retention advertised on the provider's payment comparison is a pro feature, not a verified community allowance; do not assume it is included in free. enterprise compliance, sso and premium support require separate terms. commercial-use rights remain unconfirmed.

pusher-channels-sandbox pusher channels sandbox webhooks & event delivery 200,000 messages per day; 100 concurrent connections; standard support; hosted realtime pub/sub channels a published message and each delivery to a subscribed client count separately toward the 200,000 daily message quota (one publish to 50 subscribers = 51 messages). pusher says it emails users approaching plan limits and allows some headroom for unexpected spikes; do not assume an exact hard-stop or automatic paid overage on sandbox. sla is reserved for select enterprise customers. official signup credit-card requirement remains unconfirmed.

courier-developer courier developer email & notifications 10,000 notification sends/month; journeys and broadcasts; sdks, cli and mcp server; google and github sso beyond the free monthly allowance, business pricing is $0.005 per send; downstream email/sms provider charges may apply. credit-card requirement and explicit commercial-use terms for developer not confirmed.

mailjet-free mailjet free email & notifications 6,000 emails/month; 200 emails/day; up to 1,000 contacts; api, smtp relay and event webhooks free support is limited to the first month; daily cap applies and advanced features or removal of branding require a paid plan. explicit commercial-use terms for free are unconfirmed.

composio-hobby composio hobby ai & ml platforms 100,000 tool calls/month and 50,000 trigger events/month using your own oauth app, api key or mcp; 3 team members; unlimited connected accounts; 1 million sandbox llm tokens/month composio-managed apps have smaller included allowances (20,000 tool calls and 10,000 trigger events/month); third-party provider and instant tool charges may apply separately; hobby pauses at its usage cap. commercial-use terms not independently confirmed.

chromatic-free chromatic free testing & qa 5,000 billed visual-test snapshots/month (equivalent to up to 25,000 turbosnaps); chrome browser; unlimited projects, users and collaborators visual review and testing pause at the monthly snapshot cap until reset or upgrade. safari, firefox and edge testing require a paid plan; explicit commercial-use terms unconfirmed.

memcachier-developer memcachier developer databases & caching 25 mb fully managed memcached cache; 1 proxy server; 10 connections; basic analytics and 24/7 monitoring developer tier is aimed at development; high availability, alerting and unlimited connections require paid plans. free-signup card requirement and commercial production rights are unconfirmed; unauthorized resale is prohibited.

beeceptor-free beeceptor free testing & qa 50 requests/day per public endpoint; 3 mock rules; 10 small crud objects; dynamic and conditional responses; ephemeral local tunnel free endpoints are public, with no sla. unclaimed endpoints are automatically deleted (official pages differ between 7 and 30 days); claimed endpoints expire 90 days after creation. do not send sensitive payloads.

redis-cloud-free redis cloud free databases & caching one free redis cloud database per account; 30 mb memory; 30 concurrent connections; 5 gb monthly network bandwidth; up to 100 operations/second (1 kib requests) free essentials is intended for learning and prototypes; shared deployment, best-effort sla and community support. network and throughput quotas apply; commercial production rights are not explicitly confirmed.

expo-push-service-free expo push service free email & notifications free push notification delivery through expo to fcm and apns; 600 notifications/second per project; 100 notifications per api request requires valid expo push tokens and platform push credentials; no delivery sla or guarantee of receipt on the device; expo go on android requires a development build for remote push notifications. commercial-use terms not independently confirmed.

aikido-developer-free aikido developer free authentication & security 2 users; 10 repositories; 2 container images; 1 domain; 1 cloud account; 10 ai autofixes/month; 250,000 protected requests/month rescans every 3 days; premium pr security review, integrations, and extended coverage require paid tiers. commercial-use terms not independently confirmed.

mockoon-open-source mockoon open source testing & qa unlimited local mock api servers, routes and requests using the free desktop app, cli or docker image; openapi import/export and ci integration. local-first mit-licensed edition; infrastructure for remote deployment is self-funded. real-time team collaboration, centralized administration, managed deployments and browser workspace require paid mockoon pro; its 14-day trial is not the free edition.

mailersend-free mailersend free email & notifications 500 transactional emails per month (up to 100 emails/day); 100 api requests/day; 1 sending domain, 1 api token, 1 webhook and 1 template. a credit card and account approval are required to activate free, although the plan is $0. sending pauses at the quota until reset; 14-day professional trial is separate and downgrades to free. hosted free commercial-use conditions require confirmation.

dynv6-free-dynamic-dns dynv6 free dynamic dns dns & cdn free ipv4/ipv6 dynamic dns hostname or delegated own domain, with dns record management and rest/dyndns/ssh/tsig update apis; no numeric zone or query allowance published. no sla or enterprise ddos protection; unsuitable for critical services. inactive accounts may be deleted, excessive api requests throttled, and the free service may change or end without guarantee. commercial-use terms are not explicitly confirmed.

openrouter-free-models openrouter free models ai & ml platforms 25+ free models with chat and api access; 50 free-model requests/day and 20 requests/minute without purchased credits; up to 5 workspaces. free model availability and provider routing may change; failed requests count toward daily cap. buying at least $10 credits raises free-model allowance to 1,000 requests/day. free endpoints may retain prompts; commercial rights and output licenses depend on each underlying model/provider; no sla.

hookdeck-outpost-self-hosted hookdeck outpost self-hosted webhooks & event delivery apache-2.0 open-source outbound webhook and event-destination server, self-hosted with no vendor-enforced monthly event, delivery, tenant, or user quota; supports http webhooks, queue/bus destinations, retries, fan-out and a customer portal. self-hosted software, not hookdeck's paid managed outpost or the separate hosted event gateway free plan. requires your own compute, redis, postgresql, supported message queue, security, backups and operations; third-party destination services may charge. apache-2.0 attribution applies; provider logos and trademarks are excluded.

nudgehost-free-static-hosting nudgehost free static hosting static & frontend hosting 10 active hosted links/sites on a free account; up to 25 mb per file or uploaded site zip; 2 api keys at 20 requests/minute; no visitor cap; hosted html and zip sites stay live until deleted. a free account is required for permanent links; anonymous uploads expire after 7 days. static html/css/js hosting only, no server-side runtime. custom domains and password protection require pro; default site urls may request no search indexing. free is marketed for personal files, so commercial-use rights require confirmation.

go-feature-flag-self-hosted go feature flag self-hosted feature flags & gradual rollout mit-licensed self-hosted feature flag system with unlimited feature flags and no vendor-imposed seat, evaluation or monthly request limits; openfeature sdks and stateless relay proxy. self-host and maintain the relay proxy, configuration storage and any supporting infrastructure; hosting, monitoring and maintenance costs are not included. dedicated enterprise support and security-response sla are paid separately.

byet-host-free-web-hosting byet host free web hosting backend & app hosting 5 gb nvme storage; unmetered bandwidth subject to fair use; php 8.3 and mysql 8; free ssl for provider subdomains; custom domains and up to 10 mb file uploads. free hosting is intended for personal sites and experiments. no uptime sla; high resource use, bulk email, proxy services and download/file-sharing hosting are prohibited. three free accounts maximum per person; users must maintain their own backups. commercial-use eligibility is not explicit.

valkey-self-hosted valkey self-hosted databases & caching bsd-3-clause open-source in-memory key/value datastore for standalone or clustered self-hosting; no vendor-imposed instance, request, or storage quota. you must provision and secure your own servers, memory, storage, backups and operations; no hosted free instance or managed sla is included.

ceph-self-hosted ceph self-hosted object storage free, open-source distributed object, block, and file storage on self-managed hardware; no vendor-imposed storage, request, or user quota. no managed storage capacity, hosting, or sla is included. supply and operate disks, servers, network, backups, monitoring and security; comply with lgpl 2.1/3.0 and bundled component licenses.

cerbos-pdp-self-hosted cerbos pdp self-hosted authentication & security free-forever apache-2.0 self-hosted policy decision point with yaml authorization policies, decision apis, audit logs and git/disk/cloud/db policy storage; no vendor-enforced monthly decision or user quota. requires your own hosting, security updates and operations. cerbos hub poc has separate hosted limits (100 monthly active principals); hub collaboration, managed policy delivery, enterprise features and support are not included.

jaeger-self-hosted jaeger self-hosted monitoring & observability apache-2.0 open-source distributed tracing backend with collector, query api and ui; self-hosted deployments have no vendor-imposed monthly trace, user or instance quota. provide and operate your own compute, storage backend, backups and security. default all-in-one in-memory storage loses traces on restart and is for development; production needs durable storage and appropriate scaling. no hosted free tracing service or managed sla is included.

rybbit-self-hosted rybbit self-hosted product analytics free agpl-3.0 self-hosted web and product analytics with pageviews, custom events, funnels and session replays; no vendor-imposed monthly event or pageview quota. requires your own vps (2 gb ram or more recommended), domain with https, docker, postgresql and clickhouse; hosting, backups and maintenance are not included. agpl-3.0 obligations apply; optional anonymous instance telemetry can be disabled. rybbit cloud offers a 7-day trial, not an ongoing free cloud plan.

rabbitmq-open-source-self-hosted rabbitmq open source self-hosted queues, workflows & scheduling self-hosted rabbitmq message broker under mpl-2.0, with queues, streams, amqp messaging and no vendor-imposed message, queue or connection quotas. you supply servers, storage, backups, monitoring and upgrades; capacity is infrastructure-dependent. community security patches and support are limited to currently supported release series; extended lifecycle and 24/7 vendor support require commercial tanzu rabbitmq. distinct from cloudamqp's managed little lemur tier.

woodpecker-ci-self-hosted woodpecker ci self-hosted ci/cd & pipelines free apache-2.0 ci/cd server and agents for self-hosted container-based pipelines; no vendor-imposed per-user, per-repository or build-minute quotas. requires your own server, build agents, docker-compatible execution infrastructure and git forge integration; infrastructure, maintenance and any third-party services are not included.
