semaphore-community-edition-self-hosted semaphore community edition self-hosted ci/cd & pipelines free open-source apache-2.0 community edition for self-hosted ci/cd; run jobs on own infrastructure and agents; no vendor-hosted build-minute allowance. requires self-hosting and infrastructure/agent costs; community edition lacks paid enterprise features. no vendor-managed hosting included.

quad9-public-dns quad9 public dns dns & cdn free public recursive dns resolver with malware/phishing blocking, dnssec validation, dns-over-https and dns-over-tls; no account or published monthly query quota for ordinary use. recursive dns only: does not host authoritative dns zones or provide cdn. isps, service providers and other large organizations should contact quad9 before sending large-scale dns traffic; no business sla or per-domain dns management.

librechat-self-hosted librechat self-hosted ai chatbots & assistants mit-licensed self-hosted multi-provider ai chat and agent interface, with docker compose deployment and no vendor-imposed seat, message, or monthly usage quota for the self-hosted software. operator supplies server/container resources and model access; paid model api usage, third-party services and hosting may incur costs. librechat does not bundle free model api credits; self-hosted setup requires mongodb and other services.

quickwit-self-hosted quickwit self-hosted hosted search apache-2.0 open-source search engine; no vendor-imposed search, indexing, or storage quotas for self-hosted software. operator supplies and pays for servers, object storage, backups and operations; officially supported on linux; quickwit targets log/observability search, not managed hosted search.

fission-self-hosted fission self-hosted serverless & edge free apache-2.0 kubernetes-native serverless framework for http and event-triggered functions, autoscaling and custom runtimes; no vendor-imposed execution or function-count quota for the self-hosted software. requires an existing self-managed kubernetes cluster and ongoing compute, networking, storage and operations costs. this is software for running your own functions, not a hosted faas free allowance; external services and infrastructure may charge separately.

anythingllm-self-hosted anythingllm self-hosted ai chatbots & assistants free mit-licensed self-hosted docker ai workspace with document chat/rag, configurable llm providers, agents and developer api; no vendor-imposed chat or document quota for the core software. runs on your own compute and storage. local model hardware, paid cloud llm apis, vector databases and managed anythingllm cloud plans are separate costs. secure internet-facing instances, review third-party model licenses and disable optional telemetry if desired.

knative-serving-self-hosted knative serving self-hosted serverless & edge free apache-2.0 kubernetes serverless serving layer for request-driven containers, automatic scale-to-zero, traffic splitting and revision management; no vendor-imposed application or request quota for the open-source software. requires a self-managed kubernetes cluster, compatible networking/ingress and compute capacity; infrastructure, storage, logging and operations can cost money. this is not a hosted cloud free tier. knative eventing and functions are separate components with their own setup.

vespa-search-self-hosted vespa search self-hosted hosted search apache-2.0 open-source vespa search and vector retrieval software for self-managed deployments, with no vendor-enforced query, index-size, or seat quota. you provide compute, persistent storage, operations, backups and security; local docker setup requires at least 4 gb ram. internal protocols are not authenticated by default: isolate hosts and configure access controls/tls. vespa cloud is a separate managed service.

apache-openwhisk-self-hosted apache openwhisk self-hosted serverless & edge apache-2.0 open-source event-driven serverless platform for running functions and triggers on self-managed docker or kubernetes infrastructure; no vendor-imposed function invocation or seat quota. you operate and pay for compute, containers, orchestration, persistent services, logs, security and backups. openwhisk deployment requires platform configuration; any third-party cloud infrastructure and connected services are billed separately.

dokku-self-hosted dokku self-hosted backend & app hosting mit-licensed, docker-powered self-hosted paas for git-push application deployments and lifecycle management on your own linux server; no vendor-imposed application, deployment or seat quota in the core software. not free managed hosting: supply and pay for linux server, docker, persistent volumes, networking, tls, backups and operations. core deployment is managed with cli/ssh; plugins, hosting and connected services may have separate requirements or costs.

openfga-self-hosted openfga self-hosted authentication & security apache-2.0 open-source fine-grained authorization server supporting relationship-based and attribute-based access control via http/grpc apis; no vendor-imposed authorization-check or seat quota for self-hosted software. provide and secure your own compute, persistent database, backups, tls, monitoring and availability. in-memory storage is for development; use postgresql or mysql for production. managed authorization offerings and infrastructure cost extra.

juicefs-community-self-hosted juicefs community self-hosted object storage apache-2.0 open-source posix-compatible distributed file system backed by your own object storage and metadata engine; no vendor-enforced monthly storage, file or request quota in the community software. juicefs is not free managed storage: you pay for underlying s3-compatible object storage, metadata database (such as redis or mysql), compute, network, backups and operations. commercial/enterprise edition is separate; anonymous usage telemetry is enabled by default and can be disabled.

gatus-self-hosted gatus self-hosted monitoring & observability apache-2.0 open-source self-hosted status page with configurable http, tcp, icmp and dns health checks, conditions and alerting; no vendor-enforced endpoint or check quota for self-managed software. self-hosted edition requires your own server, configuration, persistent storage, alert integrations, tls and backups. third-party alert channels may charge; gatus.io managed status pages are a separate hosted product. no managed uptime sla is included.

kserve-self-hosted kserve self-hosted ai & ml platforms apache-2.0 open-source kubernetes inference platform for predictive and generative ai models, with standardized inference apis and optional knative scale-to-zero; no vendor-imposed model-serving request or seat quota in the self-hosted software. you supply and pay for kubernetes nodes, gpus/cpus, storage, network, observability, backups and model downloads; model weights have separate licenses. knative-based serverless mode requires additional cluster components. no managed inference compute is included.

bucketeer-self-hosted bucketeer self-hosted feature flags & gradual rollout apache-2.0 open-source self-hosted feature flag management and a/b experimentation with unlimited team members, environments and evaluations; no vendor software seat or evaluation quota. you operate and pay for mysql, redis, compute, storage, tls, backups and any kubernetes/cloud integrations. docker compose lite is for smaller deployments; production requires proper security and operational setup. no managed hosting included.

asynq-self-hosted asynq self-hosted (go redis task queue) queues, workflows & scheduling mit-licensed go library for redis-backed distributed background tasks, worker concurrency, retries, delayed/periodic scheduling and priority queues; no vendor-imposed task, worker or monthly execution quota for self-managed use. requires your own go application workers and redis-compatible broker, plus compute, monitoring, backups and operations. at-least-once task execution requires idempotent handlers; not a hosted queue or free redis instance. asynq api is pre-1.0 and redis cluster compatibility requires review.

svix-server-self-hosted svix webhook server self-hosted webhooks & event delivery mit-licensed self-hosted rust webhook delivery server with message signing, retries, endpoint management and delivery handling; no vendor-enforced monthly webhook or endpoint quota for the open-source server. requires self-operated postgresql, server/worker compute, network, backups and optional redis; docker compose is a development-friendly deployment, not managed hosting. open-source server differs from hosted svix in some features and optimizations; hosted svix free is a separate catalog entry.

wasmer-edge-hobby-static wasmer edge hobby static hosting static & frontend hosting hobby plan is advertised as free forever with static-site deployment, 150 gb bandwidth, 1 gb volume/package storage, 1 million requests and 1,000 build minutes per month; custom domains and managed https/ssl supported. shared hobby limits also cover app compute (6 active cpu hours), memory and other resources; usage above allowances may incur listed charges or require upgrade. card requirement and commercial-use eligibility for the hobby plan are not independently confirmed; verify before production use.

dolt-self-hosted dolt sql database self-hosted databases & caching apache-2.0 self-hosted sql database compatible with mysql clients, supporting git-style branching, commits, diffs and merges of versioned tables; no vendor-enforced database size, query or seat quotas in the open-source server. requires your own cpu, ram, disk, backups and database operations. dolthub sharing, hosted dolt and managed support are separate offerings; git-style version control changes performance and storage considerations versus conventional mysql.

graphile-worker-self-hosted graphile worker self-hosted queues, workflows & scheduling mit-licensed node.js postgresql-backed background job queue with task scheduling, retries, concurrency and postgresql transaction integration; no vendor-enforced job, worker or monthly execution quotas when self-managed. requires your own node.js worker processes and postgresql database; database, cpu, storage, backups and monitoring are not included. tasks run at least once, so handlers should be idempotent; graphile worker is not a managed queue or free postgresql service.

hoppscotch-community-self-hosted hoppscotch community self-hosted apis & developer tools mit-licensed self-hosted community edition api development platform for http, rest, graphql and websocket testing, api collections and collaboration; no vendor subscription, request or seat quota for the community software. self-hosting requires your own application server, database, authentication setup, backups, tls and ongoing security maintenance. enterprise-only features (such as advanced sso and audit logging) and hosted cloud plans are separate; commercial use permitted under mit license.

gocd-self-hosted gocd self-hosted ci/cd & pipelines apache-2.0 open-source continuous delivery server and build agents; self-hosted pipelines without a software license fee. you operate and secure the gocd server and agents; compute, storage, plugins and supporting infrastructure are not included.

coredns-self-hosted coredns self-hosted dns & cdn apache-2.0 open-source dns server with configurable plugins for forwarding, caching, zone serving and kubernetes service discovery; no software usage quota. self-hosting requires dns configuration, port 53 access and ongoing security/availability management; infrastructure, upstream dns and cloud costs are not included.

concourse-ci-self-hosted concourse ci self-hosted ci/cd & pipelines apache-2.0 open-source container-based ci/cd automation with declarative pipelines, resources, jobs and workers; no license-based job quota. requires self-managed web and worker nodes plus postgresql; container runtime, infrastructure, maintenance and secrets security are your responsibility.

pinggy-free pinggy free tunneling & networking free-for-life http(s), tcp, udp and tls tunnels; unlimited data transfer with a 60-minute timeout per tunnel and random subdomains. free tunnel urls change when restarted or after the 60-minute timeout; persistent tunnels, custom domains/subdomains and priority support require paid pro. provider does not clearly state commercial-use eligibility for hosted free.

localhost-run-free localhost.run forever free tunneling & networking forever-free ssh-based https tunnels without signup or client download; short-lived free subdomains with rate-limited transfer. free domain names rotate and throughput is speed-limited; persistent named domains and faster transfers require paid plans. provider does not clearly specify commercial-use eligibility for free hosted tunnels.

nuclio-self-hosted nuclio self-hosted serverless & edge apache-2.0 open-source event-driven serverless function framework; run functions with http and data-stream triggers on self-managed docker or kubernetes, including cpu/gpu workloads. requires a self-managed docker host or kubernetes cluster, image builds and registry, secure network configuration and operations; compute/gpu/storage and infrastructure are not included. commercial managed nuclio services are separate.

argo-cd-self-hosted argo cd self-hosted ci/cd & pipelines free apache-2.0 gitops continuous delivery for kubernetes, with declarative application synchronization, drift detection, rollback and multi-cluster deployment. requires a self-managed kubernetes cluster, git repository access, secured credentials and ongoing operational maintenance; cluster and infrastructure costs are not included. managed commercial distributions are separate.

jan-local-ai-assistant jan local ai assistant ai chatbots & assistants free apache-2.0 desktop ai assistant for windows, macos and linux; run supported open-weight language models locally and offline, or connect optional external model providers. no jan software seat or message quota. local inference requires sufficient cpu/gpu, ram and disk space; downloaded model weights have separate licenses and commercial-use conditions. optional hosted model apis can charge fees. attribution requested where appropriate.

piku-self-hosted piku self-hosted backend & app hosting free mit-licensed micro-paas for git-push deployment of multiple apps to your own linux/unix server, with procfile workers, virtual hosts and optional https; no piku software usage or seat limits. you provide and secure your own server, ssh access, python, nginx and uwsgi; compute, bandwidth, storage, dns and tls operations are not included. best suited to small self-managed deployments.

zincsearch-self-hosted zincsearch self-hosted hosted search free apache-2.0 full-text search engine you can self-host, with schema-less indexing, rest apis, bulk ingestion, a built-in ui and disk-backed indexes; no software query or index quota. self-hosted compute, disk, backup, access control and maintenance are your responsibility. the project documents no built-in high availability; elasticsearch api compatibility is partial and not a drop-in kibana replacement.

temporal-server-self-hosted temporal server self-hosted queues, workflows & scheduling free mit-licensed durable workflow orchestration server for self-managed deployments; run application workflows, activities, task queues and retries without temporal software usage fees or managed-cloud quotas. requires operating and securing the temporal cluster, workers and persistence database (for example postgresql or mysql); high availability, backups, monitoring and infrastructure incur costs. temporal cloud is a separate paid service.

gpt4all-local-ai gpt4all local ai ai chatbots & assistants free mit-licensed local ai chat desktop application and developer bindings; download supported models, chat privately offline and use localdocs or a local api server without gpt4all software message or token fees. model weights have separate license and commercial-use terms; large downloads, ram/cpu/gpu and disk space are required. optional integrations and cloud services may have separate costs; local app is not a managed hosted api.

featurevisor-self-hosted featurevisor self-hosted feature flags & gradual rollout mit-licensed git-based feature flags, a/b experiments and remote configuration; unlimited definitions evaluated locally by sdks using self-hosted static json datafiles. requires your own git repository, ci build and hosting/cdn for generated datafiles; no managed dashboard or hosted allowance. infrastructure and delivery costs are separate; retain mit license notices.

knock-developer-free knock developer free webhooks & event delivery 10,000 notification messages/month, 500 guide active users/month and 500 ai agent credits/month; unlimited workflows, broadcasts, delivery channels and team members. a message counts per recipient and channel; sending through email/sms/push providers can incur their own charges. developer tier is for evaluation or small-scale deployments; knock does not hard-cap overages and may request billing setup if usage exceeds the free allowance.

dex-oidc-self-hosted dex oidc self-hosted authentication & security apache-2.0 self-hosted openid connect identity and oauth 2.0 provider with pluggable ldap, saml, github and other upstream identity connectors; no software usage or seat fee. dex federates to upstream identity providers rather than replacing user directories; configure tls, secure token signing keys, storage and identity connectors yourself. upstream identity services and hosting may charge separately.

shynet-self-hosted shynet self-hosted analytics product analytics apache-2.0 privacy-focused web analytics for multiple websites and users, with pageviews, sessions, referrers and device metrics; self-hosted without software usage fees or monthly tracking quota. runs on your own server with django and a database; configure https, backups, updates and privacy compliance yourself. javascript tracking is optional with a pixel fallback; no managed cloud hosting or support is included.

mlflow-self-hosted mlflow open source self-hosted ai & ml platforms apache-2.0 open-source ml/genai experiment tracking, model registry, evaluation and tracing; no software license, seat or experiment quota when self-hosted. operate and secure your own tracking server, database and artifact storage; cloud infrastructure and third-party model/api calls are not included. this is not a managed hosting allowance.

netdata-agent-self-hosted netdata agent self-hosted monitoring & observability gplv3+ open-source real-time host and container monitoring agent, free on unlimited self-hosted nodes; local dashboard available under ncul1. run your own monitoring infrastructure. netdata cloud community is a separate personal/non-commercial plan capped at 5 active connected nodes; cloud business and enterprise features are not included.

bentoml-self-hosted bentoml open source self-hosted ai & ml platforms apache-2.0 framework for packaging and serving ai/ml model inference apis, batch jobs and multi-model pipelines; no software license fee or per-model quota when self-hosted. supply and pay for your own cpu/gpu, network and model storage; model weights may have separate licenses. bentocloud managed compute is not included; anonymous framework usage telemetry can be disabled.

opentelemetry-collector-self-hosted opentelemetry collector self-hosted monitoring & observability apache-2.0 open-source telemetry pipeline to receive, process and export traces, metrics and logs without per-host or telemetry volume license charges. collector is a pipeline, not a hosted storage/search dashboard; provide your own telemetry backend, compute and network. individual collector components have differing stability levels.

seatable-cloud-free seatable cloud free databases & caching up to 25 users, unlimited bases/tables, 10,000 total rows, 2 gb file storage, 3,000 api calls/month and one month of snapshots. limits are shared per team; paid plus/enterprise needed for higher row/storage/api allowances and advanced features. separate self-hosted server plans have different user limits.

signoz-community-self-hosted signoz community self-hosted monitoring & observability free open-source community observability platform for logs, traces, metrics, dashboards and application performance monitoring on self-managed infrastructure. operate your own docker/kubernetes deployment and clickhouse storage; advanced enterprise features and support are separate. signoz cloud offers a 30-day trial, not an ongoing free cloud plan.

nextcloud-server-self-hosted nextcloud server self-hosted object storage agplv3+ open-source file sync, sharing, webdav and collaboration server with no software license fee or fixed per-user storage allowance when self-hosted. provide and secure your own disk, server, database, backups and tls; storage is limited by your infrastructure. some apps, enterprise support and hosted plans cost extra; agpl obligations apply.

gitbook-free gitbook free static & frontend hosting free hosted public documentation for one individual editor, github/gitlab sync, interactive api documentation, previews and unlimited public page views. custom domains, additional collaborators, ai assistant and analytics require paid plans; the 14-day trial shown for essential/ultimate is separate from free.

postman-free postman free apis & developer tools free individual api client and core development tools, collections/environments, api specs and mock servers, native git, manual flows and collection runner. designed for individuals; paid solo/team plans add automation, collaboration and expanded api monitoring. ai credits, mock-server usage and cloud queries have separate plan limits.

mintlify-starter-free mintlify starter free static & frontend hosting free hosted documentation site with 5 editor seats, git sync, a custom domain, web editor, search, mcp server and api playground. pro ai assistant/agent, automations, preview deployments and advanced security are paid; 14-day pro trial credits are not part of the ongoing starter allowance.

gitea-self-hosted gitea open source self-hosted ci/cd & pipelines free mit-licensed self-managed git service with unlimited users and repositories; includes git hosting, pull requests, issues, package registry and gitea actions ci/cd with self-hosted runners. no vendor-hosted ci minutes or compute are included; you operate and secure the server, storage and actions runners. enterprise support, saml sso and advanced features are paid. this is not the separate gitea cloud free trial.

powerdns-authoritative-self-hosted powerdns authoritative server self-hosted dns & cdn free gpl-2.0 licensed authoritative dns server with dnssec, zone management, api automation and zone-file or database backends; no vendor-imposed software query or zone quota. self-hosted authoritative dns requires your own public servers, dns delegation, networking, updates and monitoring; infrastructure and optional vendor support are not included. powerdns recursor and dnsdist are separate products.

forgejo-actions-self-hosted forgejo actions self-hosted ci/cd & pipelines free gpl-3.0-or-later self-hosted git forge with integrated forgejo actions ci/cd workflows, repositories, pull requests and issues; no vendor-imposed software build-minute quota. you must provide, configure and secure your own forgejo instance and actions runners; runner compute, storage and network costs are not included. forgejo actions is not guaranteed compatible with github actions and gpl obligations apply when redistributing modified binaries.

rathole-self-hosted rathole self-hosted tunneling & networking free apache-2.0 self-hosted reverse-proxy client/server for nat traversal and tcp service exposure; no software-enforced tunnel or traffic quota. requires your own publicly reachable server and client configuration with shared authentication tokens; bandwidth, server hosting, ip address, security hardening and operations are not included. not a free hosted tunnel service.

tsuru-self-hosted tsuru self-hosted paas backend & app hosting free bsd-3-clause self-hosted paas for deploying applications from source or container images with add-ons, scaling and deployment management; no software-imposed app quota. requires your own kubernetes infrastructure, networking, storage and operational maintenance; managed-cloud resources and third-party add-ons may cost money. license notices and third-party dependency terms apply.

docsgpt-self-hosted docsgpt self-hosted ai chatbots & assistants free mit-licensed self-hosted document-grounded ai agents and assistants, knowledge ingestion, cited answers, workflows and local-model support; no software license or seat fee for self-hosting. bring your own compute, storage, embeddings and language models. paid cloud/managed/enterprise offerings and third-party model api usage are separate; review model and connector licenses and secure deployments.

localtunnel-self-hosted localtunnel self-hosted tunneling & networking free mit-licensed localtunnel client and server for exposing local http services through a public url; self-hosted deployment has no software-imposed session or traffic quota. self-hosted server requires your own public host, wildcard dns, reverse proxy and tls setup; hosting and bandwidth are not free. the public localtunnel.me relay is best-effort with ephemeral urls and no guaranteed uptime or fixed subdomain.

kubero-self-hosted kubero self-hosted paas backend & app hosting free gpl-3.0 self-hosted kubernetes paas with app deployments, ci/cd pipelines, staging environments, gitops review apps and add-on integration; no software-imposed application quota. requires a kubernetes cluster and your own compute, storage, networking and maintenance. gpl-3.0 obligations apply when redistributing modified software; external add-ons and cloud infrastructure can incur charges.

chroma-self-hosted chroma self-hosted databases & caching free apache-2.0 open-source vector database for embeddings and similarity search, available as an embedded local store or self-hosted client/server; no vendor-imposed software vector or query quota. self-hosted chroma is distinct from metered chroma cloud with introductory $5 credits. you provide storage, backups, access controls, hosting and any external embedding-model/api costs; production scaling and security are your responsibility.

milvus-self-hosted milvus self-hosted databases & caching free apache-2.0 open-source vector database for semantic, hybrid and full-text search, with standalone docker and distributed kubernetes deployment; no vendor-imposed software vector or query quota. self-hosted edition only; compute, ram, storage, networking, backups and operations are your responsibility. zilliz managed cloud is a separate paid/limited service; infrastructure and optional model/embedding api usage may cost money.

featbit-foundation-self-hosted featbit foundation self-hosted feature flags & gradual rollout free-forever self-hosted foundation feature flag platform with feature toggles, targeting, sdks and integrations; official pricing states no limits on seats, mau, projects or service connections. open-core product: some enterprise capabilities, advanced rbac, support and licensed features require a paid key; the core code is mit licensed but not all repository features are unrestricted. requires your own infrastructure, database, upgrades and security operations.

open-web-analytics-self-hosted open web analytics self-hosted product analytics free gpl-2.0-or-later self-hosted web analytics server for unlimited websites, pageviews, events, e-commerce tracking and reporting; no vendor-imposed software analytics quota. you must host and maintain the php application and database, secure admin access, configure privacy/consent and cookie retention as applicable, and comply with gpl obligations for redistribution. infrastructure and maintenance costs are not included.

apache-solr-self-hosted apache solr self-hosted hosted search free apache-2.0 open-source full-text, vector and geospatial search server with http apis, indexing, facets, replication and distributed solrcloud; no vendor-imposed software index or query quota. self-hosting requires jvm resources, storage, network security, patching, backups and operational expertise; optional cloud infrastructure, managed services and third-party integrations cost extra.

apache-pulsar-self-hosted apache pulsar self-hosted queues, workflows & scheduling free apache-2.0 self-hosted distributed publish-subscribe messaging and streaming platform with durable topics, subscriptions, queue semantics, multi-tenancy and geo-replication; no vendor-imposed software message quota. requires self-managed brokers, persistent storage/bookkeeper, metadata services, network security, monitoring and operational expertise. cloud infrastructure, managed pulsar and optional connectors can incur charges.

nats-jetstream-self-hosted nats jetstream self-hosted queues, workflows & scheduling free apache-2.0 self-hosted nats messaging server with jetstream durable streams, queue consumers, replay, key-value and object storage; no vendor-imposed software message or stream quota. you must operate your own nats server/cluster and configure jetstream persistence, storage limits, authentication, replication and backups. infrastructure, bandwidth and managed nats/synadia offerings are separate and may cost money.

apache-kafka-self-hosted apache kafka self-hosted queues, workflows & scheduling free apache-2.0 self-hosted distributed event streaming platform with durable topics, consumer groups, kafka connect and streams; no vendor-imposed software message or topic quota. requires your own kafka brokers/kraft controllers, compute, disks, networking, monitoring, security, upgrades and backups. managed kafka, cloud infrastructure and third-party connectors may have separate charges.

swagger-ui-self-hosted swagger ui self-hosted apis & developer tools apache-2.0 openapi/swagger interactive api documentation renderer; self-host the static ui assets or embed its npm modules with no software license or usage quota. requires an openapi specification and your own hosting; cors and authentication configuration may be necessary. swaggerhub hosted collaboration products are separate paid offerings.

centrifugo-self-hosted centrifugo self-hosted webhooks & event delivery apache-2.0 open-source real-time pub/sub messaging server for websocket, sse, http streaming and grpc clients; self-host without a software message quota. this is real-time event delivery, not a managed webhook saas; requires your own servers and optional redis/postgresql/nats brokers. secure production authentication and tls; infrastructure costs apply.

ory-kratos-self-hosted ory kratos self-hosted authentication & security apache-2.0 open-source identity server: self-host login, registration, recovery, verification, mfa and identity apis without a per-user software license fee. requires your own infrastructure, database, ui and email/sms services; ory enterprise license is separate for enterprise features, guaranteed security patches, support and slas. not the hosted ory network plan.

grafana-alloy-self-hosted grafana alloy self-hosted monitoring & observability apache-2.0 open-source opentelemetry collector for metrics, logs, traces and profiles; self-host collectors without a software usage quota. alloy is a telemetry collector, not a durable storage, query or dashboard backend; storage, processing, managed grafana cloud and infrastructure can cost extra.

read-the-docs-community read the docs community static & frontend hosting free ongoing hosted public documentation builds and versioned sites for eligible open-source software projects, supported by ads. community hosting is for free/open-source projects using public repositories and public docs; commercial/non-free projects and private docs require read the docs business (paid after trial).

openstack-swift-self-hosted openstack swift self-hosted object storage apache-2.0 open-source distributed object/blob storage service with an http object-storage api; no software storage or request quota when self-hosted. requires your own storage nodes, networking, capacity planning, operations and often an authentication service; disk, bandwidth and infrastructure are not free. not a hosted storage allowance.

redoc-self-hosted redoc self-hosted apis & developer tools mit-licensed openapi/swagger api reference documentation renderer; self-host or embed the open-source redoc ui with no software usage quota. this is the free open-source renderer, not redocly's paid hosted api documentation platform; requires an openapi specification and your own hosting/integration.

ray-serve-self-hosted ray serve self-hosted ai & ml platforms apache-2.0 open-source model serving and inference apis on ray; run locally, on-premises or on your own kubernetes/compute infrastructure with no software request quota. requires your own cpu/gpu capacity and ray deployment; large models, accelerators, storage and external apis cost extra. ray serve is not a fully managed free inference service.

kubeflow-community-distribution kubeflow community distribution ai & ml platforms apache-2.0 community-maintained kubernetes-native ai/ml platform distribution; self-host training, notebooks and ml pipeline components without a software subscription. requires a kubernetes cluster and substantial infrastructure and operational resources; managed vendor distributions and enterprise support may cost extra. some experimental subprojects are not production-ready.

hurricane-electric-free-dns hurricane electric free dns dns & cdn free authoritative forward and reverse dns hosting with ipv4/ipv6 support, dynamic dns updates, secondary/slave zones, and a, aaaa, cname, mx, txt, caa, srv and other record types. bring your own registered domain; reverse dns delegation depends on the ip allocation holder. the provider labels this an open beta and does not publish a guaranteed dns query quota or commercial sla; account/card and commercial-use terms require confirmation.

keda-self-hosted keda self-hosted serverless & edge apache-2.0 kubernetes event-driven autoscaler for containers and jobs; scales workloads from zero replicas based on queue lengths, events, and external metrics, without a software-side request or replica quota. requires an existing kubernetes cluster, compatible metrics/event sources and operating capacity; worker nodes, cloud event services and monitoring can incur charges. keda is an autoscaling component, not a hosted function runtime.

openfunction-self-hosted openfunction self-hosted serverless & edge apache-2.0 open-source kubernetes function-as-a-service platform for synchronous and asynchronous functions, oci image builds and event-driven scale-to-zero, with no software subscription or invocation quota. requires self-managed kubernetes and supporting build, event and runtime components (including dependencies such as dapr); compute, networking, registries and third-party event sources may cost extra. cncf sandbox project; no managed free cloud hosting is included.

dokploy-self-hosted dokploy self-hosted backend & app hosting free apache-2.0 open-source core for self-hosting application, docker compose and database deployments on your own servers, without a per-app or per-deployment software subscription. provide and pay for vps/bare-metal resources, storage, backups, domains and networking. managed dokploy cloud is paid after a trial; enterprise features under proprietary/ use a separate paid source-available license. only the open-source core is covered.

pangolin-community-self-hosted pangolin community edition self-hosted tunneling & networking free agpl-3.0 self-hosted secure networking and reverse-proxy platform with wireguard-based tunnels, sites, resources and users, using the community edition without a software subscription. requires your own server, dns, tls, networking and ongoing maintenance. community edition is agpl-3.0 (comply with source-sharing obligations); sso, advanced rbac, audit logs, high availability and other enterprise controls are paid. the free enterprise personal-use license has separate revenue and eligibility limits and is not this plan.

nebula-overlay-self-hosted nebula overlay network self-hosted tunneling & networking mit-licensed open-source encrypted peer-to-peer overlay network using certificate-based identity, built-in firewall rules and self-managed lighthouse discovery; no vendor-imposed node or traffic quota in the software. you must provision and maintain lighthouse/peer nodes, certificates, networking, routing and any relay infrastructure. cloud servers, egress, mobile platform dependencies and operations can cost extra; no hosted free vpn service or managed sla is included.

aider-local-ai-coding aider local ai coding assistant ai chatbots & assistants apache-2.0 open-source terminal ai pair-programming tool with repository mapping, git integration and code editing; run with your own ollama/local models without an aider software subscription or vendor-imposed message quota. no free hosted model credits are bundled. local models require suitable ram/gpu and may produce lower-quality edits; paid llm apis, compute and third-party services cost extra. review each model's separate commercial license and security before granting file/command access.

cline-open-source-coding-agent cline open-source coding agent ai chatbots & assistants apache-2.0 open-source ai coding agent for ide, cli and sdk, with code editing, terminal tools and support for locally hosted models; no subscription or software usage quota for the open-source agent. requires a compatible model: hosted llm apis, optional cline credits, local inference hardware and external tools may cost extra. agent access to repositories and terminal commands requires careful approvals and sandboxing; enterprise/team services are separate paid products.

fluxcd-gitops-self-hosted flux cd gitops self-hosted ci/cd & pipelines apache-2.0 open-source gitops continuous delivery controllers and cli for kubernetes; reconcile git/oci/helm sources, deploy kustomize and helm resources, and automate image updates without a vendor-imposed software usage quota. requires a user-managed kubernetes cluster, registry/source repositories, and operations; cluster compute, storage, network, registry, and external integrations may cost money. flux v1 is end-of-life; this listing covers actively maintained flux v2 only.

pagefind-static-search pagefind static site search hosted search mit-licensed fully static full-text search indexer and browser-side search ui for built html websites; no vendor-imposed query, site, or document quota and no hosted search server required. you must run indexing during your site build and host the generated static search bundle yourself. hosting/cdn bandwidth and ci build resources may cost money; large indexes increase build and client download costs. this is software, not a managed hosted search plan.

orama-js-open-source orama open-source javascript search hosted search apache-2.0 open-source @orama/orama search library for browser, node.js, and edge runtimes, with full-text, vector and hybrid search, filtering, and facets; no vendor-imposed query or document quota for the self-managed library. this is an embedded library, not the managed orama cloud plan. you manage indexes, persistence, deployment and compute; optional embeddings, ai models, hosting, or commercial cloud features may incur separate costs. see repository license.md for apache-2.0 terms.

adnanh-webhook-self-hosted adnanh/webhook self-hosted webhooks & event delivery mit-licensed self-hosted http webhook receiver that maps configurable json/yaml hook rules to local commands or scripts; no vendor-imposed webhook, endpoint, or event quota. executes server-side commands: secure every exposed hook with signatures, trigger rules, least-privilege accounts and https/reverse proxy before production use. requires your own host and operations; compute, bandwidth, tls infrastructure and integrations may cost extra. no hosted delivery/retry service is included.

flagger-progressive-delivery flagger progressive delivery self-hosted ci/cd & pipelines apache-2.0 open-source kubernetes progressive delivery operator supporting automated canary, a/b, and blue/green rollouts with metrics-based promotion and rollback; no vendor-imposed software deployment quota. requires a kubernetes cluster, compatible ingress controller/service mesh or gateway api, monitoring metrics, and deployment operations. cluster, load balancer, observability and network resources may cost extra; this is not a managed hosted cd plan.

lancedb-open-source-embedded lancedb open-source embedded databases & caching apache-2.0 open-source embedded vector and multimodal database for python, javascript and rust; local/self-managed storage, vector/full-text search and metadata filtering with no vendor-imposed software query or document quota. this is the self-managed open-source library, not managed lancedb cloud. you provide storage, indexing, compute, backups and operations; cloud object storage, embeddings and ai services may cost money. observe apache-2.0 notices.

struisict-smtp-test-tool struisict smtp test tool testing & qa free local cli and gui binaries for smtp, imap and pop3 connectivity diagnostics, tls/authentication testing, email dns checks (mx/spf/dmarc/dkim), and optional microsoft 365 oauth; no software subscription, vendor-imposed usage quota or expiration. local diagnostic tool, not a hosted smtp relay or free mailbox. requires access to existing mail servers and valid credentials; external mail-provider charges and rate limits still apply. optional dns and oauth features depend on network access and microsoft 365 permissions; some test actions interact with real mail systems.

surveyjs-ai-form-response-extractor surveyjs ai form response extractor forms & surveys mit-licensed javascript library for extracting structured answers from scanned paper forms, images and pdfs into surveyjs response schemas using a configured multimodal llm; no vendor-imposed software usage quota or expiry. library is free, not a hosted document-processing allowance. requires a supported multimodal model (openai, anthropic or self-hosted ollama); paid model apis, compute and storage may cost extra. extraction confidence is not a guarantee; review sensitive or low-confidence responses. surveyjs creator is separately commercially licensed for production.

surveyjs-form-library-local surveyjs form library open source forms & surveys free mit-licensed javascript library for embedding dynamic forms, multi-step surveys and quizzes in web applications; no vendor-imposed form or submission quotas in the open-source library. form library is a client-side renderer, not surveyjs cloud hosting or a response database. you must supply and operate your own backend/storage. survey creator, pdf generator and dashboard are separate paid proprietary products; do not assume their developer licenses are included.

surveyplanet-free surveyplanet free surveys forms & surveys unlimited hosted surveys, questions and responses in the $0 basic plan, with anonymous surveys, embedding, basic themes and in-app reporting. csv/excel export, advanced branching, custom themes and some premium reporting/sharing features require surveyplanet pro. the hosted free offer is separate from any self-hosted software; payment-card and commercial-use terms are not explicitly confirmed.

swaks-local-smtp-protocol-tester swaks local smtp protocol tester testing & qa free gpl-2.0-licensed command-line smtp/esmtp/lmtp protocol testing utility with tls, authentication and scripted message transactions; no vendor-hosted sending quota. runs on user-provided systems and requires access to an smtp server for tests; external smtp delivery, accounts and infrastructure are not included. maintained by one developer without guaranteed support.

taurus-load-testing taurus open source load testing testing & qa free apache-2.0 open-source local test orchestration cli (bzt) for performance and functional testing with jmeter, gatling, locust and selenium; no taurus software usage quota or expiry. requires installing and configuring underlying test runners; compute, ci infrastructure, target services and optional blazemeter hosted reporting can cost money. free software does not include hosted load generators.

temps-self-hosted-paas temps self-hosted paas backend & app hosting free open-source self-hosted paas with unlimited local projects, deployments and users; git push deployments, managed service provisioning, analytics, session replay, error monitoring and uptime monitoring. the mit/apache-2.0 licensed self-hosted software is free, but servers, storage, networking, database resources and email-delivery infrastructure are not included. temps cloud and enterprise/premium features are separate paid offerings; do not confuse them with free self-hosting.

teploy-cli-self-hosted teploy cli self-hosted ci/cd & pipelines free open-source cli for ssh-based zero-downtime docker deployments on your own server; automatic rollback, caddy https, multi-server support, previews and configuration-based deploys. the cli and related open-source tools have no teploy subscription, account or usage meter, but require your own servers, docker/ssh infrastructure and operational management. teploy cloud is a separate paid managed offering; comply with the applicable mit/agpl license.

terramate-cli-local-iac terramate open-source iac orchestration cli (local) ci/cd & pipelines mpl-2.0-licensed terramate cli for local iac stack orchestration, change detection and code generation without a cli license fee or fixed usage quota. terramate cloud is an optional separately managed product with its own plans; terraform/opentofu providers, cloud infrastructure, ci runners and state storage can cost money. mpl-2.0 distribution obligations apply.

testcontainers-open-source-local testcontainers open source (local) testing & qa mit-licensed testcontainers libraries provide reusable, disposable docker containers for integration tests without a software usage quota or expiration; local docker runtime and compute are supplied by the user. this entry covers open-source local testcontainers libraries, not testcontainers cloud or paid hosted resources. requires a compatible container runtime; ci infrastructure, images, network traffic and hosted compute may incur charges.

testnizer-offline-api-testing testnizer offline api testing testing & qa free mit-licensed offline desktop api testing client for http/rest, soap, graphql, grpc, websocket, sse and mcp, with local sqlite collections and test suites; no vendor-enforced request, seat or time quota for the locally run software. runs on the user's windows, macos or linux computer; not a hosted api testing service. network api providers, ai model apis and external services may impose separate fees or quotas. beta binaries may show os signing warnings; verify downloads and do not assume production security certification.

textbee-free-sms-gateway textbee free sms gateway email & notifications hosted free plan: 1 active android device, up to 50 sms messages/day and 300 sms messages/month; send/receive sms and webhook notifications. requires android 7+ phone and own sim/carrier plan; carrier sms charges and fair-use restrictions apply. hosted plan is not free sms infrastructure; commercial eligibility and provider terms should be checked before business use.

tickhook-self-hosted tickhook self-hosted webhook scheduler webhooks & event delivery mit-licensed self-hosted webhook scheduler for one-shot and fixed-interval recurring http jobs; no vendor-imposed job quota or software expiry. redis and compute are user-provided. requires redis and self-managed hosting; v1 is single-consumer, at-least-once delivery with no ha or cron expressions, and a documented crash window may lose jobs. secure the bearer token and account for infrastructure and outbound api costs.

tideform-self-hosted tideform self-hosted forms & surveys mit-licensed self-hosted form builder with form creation, response collection and analytics; no software usage quota or expiry stated. hosting, postgresql, storage and bandwidth are not included. anthropic ai features may incur api charges. upstream roadmap lists conditional logic, csv export and integrations as incomplete; verify production readiness before sensitive deployments.

tokajer-smtprelayd-self-hosted smtprelayd self-hosted smtp relay email & notifications gpl-3.0-or-later self-hosted smtp relay software for windows and linux with durable queue, smtp submission, routing, oauth2/xoauth2 microsoft 365 smarthost integration, json api and metrics; no vendor software quota or expiry. not a free mailbox or hosted email sending service. requires your own windows/linux host, secure smtp configuration and an existing smarthost (such as microsoft 365) with separate licensing, sending limits and possible charges. harden network access to avoid an open relay; upstream reports production use but deployment security remains operator responsibility.

tpt-email-provider-self-hosted tpt email provider self-hosted email & notifications mit-licensed self-hosted windows smtp/imap email server with rest api and dashboard; no software license fee, vendor-imposed message quota or expiration documented. requires windows 10/11 or windows server, node.js 20+, self-managed infrastructure, static ip, business-grade connectivity and reverse dns for deliverability. isp port restrictions, ip reputation, domain, storage and operations may incur costs. no free hosted email delivery or infrastructure is included; production security and deliverability require independent assessment.

twitterapi-io-signup-credits twitterapi.io new-account credits apis & developer tools up to $1 (100,000 api credits) as a one-time new-account sign-up allowance after an automated bot check; credits expire 31 days after issuance. not an ongoing free tier or recurring monthly credit. one offer per person/network; another signup on the same ip within 30 days may receive only $0.10. a valid sign-up bonus may be denied by anti-abuse checks. subsequent api usage requires paid top-ups or subscriptions, with usage-based credit consumption and minimum request charges. commercial use and x content/data licensing restrictions must be verified for the specific use case.

uppcoder-spark uppcoder spark free backend & app hosting 1 hosted app with 1 postgresql, mysql or mariadb database, 2 gb ram and 2 gb disk; browser vs code, terminal, ssh, https and nightly backups included free spark requires signup and email verification but no payment card, with no stated end date. limited to one app and one database; check provider resource/usage quotas and paid upgrade terms before deploying. the provider promises at least 60 days' email notice if it changes or withdraws spark. commercial-use eligibility is not explicitly confirmed.

vaex-local-dataframe vaex open-source out-of-core dataframes (local) product analytics mit-licensed python library for local out-of-core tabular data exploration, aggregation and visualization; no software license fee or vendor-metered usage quota. user supplies compute, memory and disk; very large data, external data stores and optional professional support can incur costs. this is local software, not a hosted analytics saas allowance. mit license notices apply.

vaultsandbox-self-hosted-smtp-testing-gateway vaultsandbox self-hosted smtp testing gateway testing & qa apache-2.0 licensed self-hosted smtp testing gateway with web ui, rest api, spf/dkim/dmarc checks, tls and configurable email retention; no software quota or expiration stated. public beta; self-hosted receive-only testing gateway, not a free hosted email-sending service. provide compute, storage, dns or vsx dns, and reachable ports; 7-day retention is the configurable default. infrastructure costs apply.

vegha-local-api-client vegha local api testing client testing & qa free mit-licensed local desktop api client and headless cli for http, graphql, grpc, websocket and soap testing, assertions, scripting, local collections and import; no software usage quota or expiration stated. runs on user-provided windows, macos or linux hardware; cloud hosting and managed test execution are not included. external apis, azure key vault or aws secrets manager may incur separate provider charges. some integrations are roadmap-only.

vercel-for-startups-credits vercel for startups credits static & frontend hosting up to $30,000 in a one-time vercel flexible platform credit commitment over one year for approved partner-affiliated startups, covering eligible compute, data transfer, seats, ai gateway, v0 and other vercel services. startup must be series a or earlier, within 12 months of its latest funding, have a company website/email and proof of partner affiliation; previous startup-credit recipients are excluded. actual award varies by partner. a valid payment method is mandatory. only up to 50% of the commitment may be applied to ai gateway and unused balance expires after one year; paid rates apply afterward.

vessel-local-vps-control-plane vessel local vps control plane cloud compute & vps mit-licensed desktop vps management application for windows, linux and macos; no software subscription, usage quota or expiry. connects over ssh/sftp to manage remote files, systemd services, docker, nginx/caddy and server resources. free software only: no vps, compute, bandwidth or hosting is included. requires an existing linux server and ssh credentials; remote infrastructure and any third-party services may incur charges. project is early-stage; validate security and compatibility before production use.

vibeboard-self-hosted-conference-cfp vibeboard self-hosted conference cfp forms & surveys mit-licensed self-managed conference proposal forms, submissions, reviewer scorecards, speaker onboarding and event scheduling; no software-enforced submission quota published. requires deployment to your own cloudflare account and associated workers/database/storage resources; cloudflare usage limits and potential charges apply. specialized for conference calls for papers, not a general survey saas. email delivery integrations may incur costs.

victorantos-email-verifier-local victor antos email verifier cli email & notifications free mit-licensed python cli for local csv email validation using syntax, mx and smtp rcpt checks; no software-imposed usage quota or expiration. requires python 3.9+, dns/network access and outbound smtp port 25; large mailbox providers may return unknown results, and bulk smtp probing may violate provider policies or local law. run only on addresses you are authorized to verify; infrastructure and network costs are not included.

vitest-open-source-local vitest open-source test runner testing & qa mit-licensed local javascript/typescript test runner with unit and component testing, snapshots and coverage integration; no vendor-metered test runs or license fee. runs on your own node.js development or ci environment; test execution, browser runners and paid ci infrastructure can incur costs. current documentation requires compatible node.js and vite versions; this is not a hosted test-execution allowance.

zero-email-self-hosted zero open-source self-hosted email app email & notifications free mit-licensed open-source self-hostable email application with a unified inbox, external email-provider integrations and optional ai-assisted features; no license fee or vendor-provided hosting quota for self-running the code. this is an email app/client, not a free hosted mailbox or smtp delivery service. self-hosting requires node.js, postgresql, docker and appropriate configuration; gmail/outlook access, google oauth, ai models, cloudflare storage/workers, twilio, autumn or other integrations may require credentials and incur separate charges. mit copyright/license notices apply.

zoho-forms-free zoho forms free forms & surveys three hosted forms, 500 submissions/month, 200 mb file storage and one user on the free plan; includes up to ten payment submissions per month and basic webhook integrations. the 500-submission limit resets monthly. multi-user access, branding removal, custom domains and some advanced workflow options require paid tiers; payment processor fees can apply separately. free plan card requirement and commercial-use terms are not explicitly verified.

zorvik-local-api-testing zorvik local api testing workbench testing & qa free local desktop and cli api testing, mocking and load testing on windows, macos and linux; all features included without account, subscription, seat quota or expiry. runs on user-provided hardware; api targets, network access and any external services may incur separate costs. no free hosted compute or managed testing capacity is included. mit or apache-2.0 license; follow license notices.

zoyla-http-load-testing zoyla http load testing testing & qa free mit-licensed desktop http load-testing application for windows, macos and linux; run local http/2 load tests with live rps, latency, throughput and error metrics, saved test configurations, and json/csv export. no software usage quota or expiry is stated. runs on the user's own computer; cpu, network traffic, test targets and any external infrastructure are not provided free. macos and windows installers are not code-signed and may trigger os security warnings. no hosted load generators are included.
